+def _make_permutation_context(local_tokens, global_tokens):
+    return AscendPCPAttentionContext(
+        global_batch=SimpleNamespace(is_dummy=True, num_tokens_after_padding=global_tokens),
+        global_block_tables=(),
+        global_slot_mappings=torch.empty(0),
+        hidden_restore_idx=torch.arange(global_tokens),
+        local_num_tokens=local_tokens,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "local_tokens,global_tokens,expected",
+    [
+        (2, 4, [0, 1, 2, 3]),
+        (2, 3, [0, 1, 2, 0]),
+        (3, 3, [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_glm_metadata_refreshes_capture_indices_without_mutating_pcp(local_tokens, global_tokens, expected):
+    builder = _make_permutation_builder()
+    capture_context = _make_permutation_context(local_tokens, global_tokens)
+    captured = builder._attach_pcp_permutation(SimpleNamespace(pcp_context=capture_context))
+    indices = captured.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx
+    assert indices.tolist() == expected
+    assert capture_context.padded_gather_idx is None
+    # The graph keeps this address while subsequent batches change ownership.
+    source = torch.arange(2 * local_tokens).flip(0) % global_tokens
+    live_context = replace(
+        capture_context,
+        global_batch=SimpleNamespace(is_dummy=False),
+        padded_gather_idx=source,
+    )
+    live = builder._attach_pcp_permutation(SimpleNamespace(pcp_context=live_context))
+    assert live.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx.data_ptr() == indices.data_ptr()
+    assert indices.data_ptr() != source.data_ptr()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(indices, source)
+    assert live_context.padded_gather_idx is source
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("invalid", ["missing-layout", "short-layout", "capacity", "empty-local", "empty-global"])
+def test_glm_metadata_rejects_invalid_permutations(invalid):
+    builder = _make_permutation_builder()
+    context = _make_permutation_context(2, 4)
+    if invalid == "missing-layout":
+        context.global_batch.is_dummy = False
+    elif invalid == "short-layout":
+        context = replace(context, padded_gather_idx=torch.arange(3))
+    elif invalid == "capacity":
+        builder._pcp_gather_indices = torch.empty(3, dtype=torch.int64)
+    elif invalid == "empty-local":
+        context = replace(context, local_num_tokens=0)
+    else:
+        context.global_batch.num_tokens_after_padding = 0
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="GLM KDA PCP"):
+        builder._attach_pcp_permutation(SimpleNamespace(pcp_context=context))
+

+def test_glm_build_attaches_model_owned_permutation(builder_cls, base_cls):
+    builder = _make_permutation_builder(builder_cls)
+    context = _make_permutation_context(2, 4)
+    common = SimpleNamespace()
+    base_metadata = SimpleNamespace(pcp_context=context)
+    with patch.object(base_cls, "build", return_value=base_metadata) as build:
+        metadata = builder.build(0, common)
+    build.assert_called_once_with(0, common)
+    assert metadata is base_metadata
+    assert metadata.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx.data_ptr() == builder._pcp_gather_indices.data_ptr()
+    assert metadata.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx.tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3]

+def test_replicated_decode_skips_permutation_until_prefill():
+    builder = _make_permutation_builder()
+    builder._is_pcp_decode_sharded = False
+    builder._pcp_gather_indices.fill_(-1)
+    source = torch.tensor([0, 1, 0, 1])
+    context = replace(
+        _make_permutation_context(2, 2),
+        global_batch=SimpleNamespace(is_dummy=False, is_prefilling_np=torch.tensor([False]), has_prefill=False),
+        padded_gather_idx=source,
+    )
+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(pcp_context=context)
+    assert builder._attach_pcp_permutation(metadata) is metadata
+    assert metadata.pcp_context is context
+    assert metadata.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx is source
+    assert torch.all(builder._pcp_gather_indices == -1)
+
+    # A later prefill must still refresh the persistent graph-owned storage.
+    context.global_batch.is_prefilling_np[0] = True
+    context.global_batch.has_prefill = True
+    metadata = builder._attach_pcp_permutation(metadata)
+    assert metadata.pcp_context is not context
+    assert metadata.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx.data_ptr() == builder._pcp_gather_indices.data_ptr()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(metadata.pcp_context.padded_gather_idx, source)
+    assert context.padded_gather_idx is source

commits.message:
[BugFix][KV Pool] Allow joint TP and PCP for sharded Mamba state (#22834)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

AscendStore rejects sharded Mamba configurations at connector
initialization when both TP and PCP are greater than one. Remove that
constructor check so these configurations reach the existing pool
initialization path.

The corresponding unit test now includes sharded Mamba at TP2/PCP2, and
the obsolete rejection test is removed.

The Decode node (`kv_role="kv_consumer"`) does not read from KV Pool by
default: `consumer_is_to_load` defaults to `false`, and the scheduler
returns before performing a pool lookup unless loading is explicitly
enabled. See the [official configuration
table](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/984ee29a6341c7e04ec5d418614b2d05ca36c63f/docs/source/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#L1612-L1615)
and [consumer lookup
guard](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/7c453be3b73da81bdf4fef5ac5db9162685ce03a/vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/pool_scheduler.py#L267-L270).

The [official AscendStore
guide](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/984ee29a6341c7e04ec5d418614b2d05ca36c63f/docs/source/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#L55-L63)
states: "Writers and readers must agree on transfer mode and cache
layout". When Decode-side pool loading is explicitly enabled, Prefill
writers and Decode readers sharing those pool objects must use the same
transfer mode and cache layout.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. AscendStore accepts sharded Mamba configurations with both
`--tensor-parallel-size` and `--prefill-context-parallel-size` greater
than 1. Existing shared-pool cache-layout requirements continue to
apply.

The PR contains only the connector and its unit tests.

### How was this patch tested?

- Selected connector tests on the local Windows CPU harness: **21
passed, 13 subtests passed**. The harness uses the repository's
optional-vLLM mocks, scoped attention-fence fixture, and a PP=1 import
shim because vLLM is not installed locally. Pool factories are mocked;
these tests verify initialization and dispatch.
- Ruff lint/format, forbidden-import, boolean-context-manager,
long-function, and whitespace checks passed.
- A full `bash format.sh ci` attempt previously encountered Windows
toolchain limitations, including actionlint installation and missing
shellcheck. Complete repository checks and supported-environment CPU UT
are delegated to CI.
- **NPU/backend E2E: CI testing only.**

```shell
TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 pytest -q \
  tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_ascend_store_connector.py::TestAscendStoreConnector
```

Implementation and local validation were AI-assisted.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

[Feature] A2/A3 fold Q/K L2 normalization into the FLA NPU GDN prefill kernel (#21678)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Cut the work the A2/A3 GDN chunked prefill adaptor does around the FLA
NPU GDN kernel:
let the kernel normalize q/k itself, and stop materializing copies that
only existed to
satisfy the old call signature.

- Drop the two standalone l2norm_fwd launches on q and k and pass
use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True instead.
- Replace the unconditional transpose(1,2).contiguous() on q/k/v with a
contiguity check: reuse the head-first view when the transpose is
already contiguous (layout=BNSD), otherwise pass the sequence-major
contiguous tensors (layout=BSND).
- Switch the kernel call to state_v_first=True and remove
initial_state.transpose(-1,-2) on both input and output; the keep_meta
scatter now runs on a clone of the caller's full state.

Scope: only BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill in
vllm_ascend/device/device_op.py.

Why this is worth it: GDN prefill is performance-sensitive on A2/A3 (see
flash-linear-attention-npu issue 656). Per prefill layer the adaptor
previously paid two extra kernel launches and several full-size tensor
copies for no functional gain. No numerical change is expected: the
in-kernel L2 norm computes the same q/k normalization that the removed
l2norm_fwd calls did.

Existing test updated:
tests/ut/ops/test_gdn_layout.py::test_head_first_l2norm_fallback_accepts_multiple_heads
asserted the previous contract (external l2norm_fwd plus unconditional
BNSD). It now checks the
in-kernel normalization flag and the contiguity-driven BNSD/BSND choice
instead.

#### External prerequisite

This change depends on fla_npu work that is now available in the 26.10.0
release branch.

vllm-ascend currently pairs with fla_npu 26.9.1 (mkdocs.yml,
release_fla_npu_version), which predates that
work. Until the pairing is bumped to a 26.10.0-based build, the
optimized prefill path this patch relies on
is not what ships with a stock wheel.

This PR should therefore land together with, or after, the fla_npu
26.10.0 pairing bump.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

NO

### How was this patch tested?

- New CPU regression tests: tests/ut/device/test_fla_gdn_prefill.py (7
cases) verifies the kernel argument
contract, the BNSD/BSND layout selection, the untransposed recurrent
state, the keep_meta scatter, and the
  g/beta dtype casting. A recording stand-in replaces the fused kernel.
- Existing test updated:
tests/ut/ops/test_gdn_layout.py::test_head_first_l2norm_fallback_accepts_multiple_heads
now asserts the in-kernel normalization flag and the contiguity-driven
layout choice.
- Formats and dtypes follow the operator contract in
flash-linear-attention-npu issue 656: bf16 q/k/v,
K and V equal to 128, chunk_size 64, HV an integer multiple of HK, B=1
HK=16 HV=32.
- ruff check and py_compile pass on the changed files.
- Not executed in the author environment: the development host is
Windows, where vllm_ascend.device.device_op
cannot be imported because torch_npu, vllm and triton publish no Windows
distributions. These cases are
  expected to run in CI.
- Accuracy was verified on A2/A3 through the fla_npu.ops.ascendc entry
point: the in-kernel L2 normalization
  reproduces the q/k normalization of the removed l2norm_fwd calls.

Outstanding before merge: CI green on the new test files; a fla_npu
26.10.0-based pairing; per-layer latency
numbers on A2/A3.


- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

---------

Signed-off-by: ziminMIAO <2504285866@qq.com>
Co-authored-by: ziminMIAO <2504285866@qq.com>

+"""CPU-only unit tests for the A2/A3 FLA NPU GDN prefill adaptor.
+
+Tests the BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill argument shim around the FLA
+kernel, verifying the optimized parameter contract:
+
+* q/k/v are handed over head-first (BNSD) without copying when the transpose
+  is already contiguous, and as sequence-major (BSND) otherwise;
+* q/k normalization is delegated to the kernel (use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True);
+* beta arrives already sigmoided from fused_gdn_gating, so the kernel must not
+  apply it again (use_beta_sigmoid_in_kernel=False);
+* the recurrent state keeps its [N, Hv, Dk, Dv] layout (state_v_first=True);
+* use_exp2=False, disable_recompute=False for the A2/A3 optimized path.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+from unittest import TestCase, main
+
+import torch
+import vllm  # noqa: F401 - Initialize vLLM before Ascend adaptors.
+
+import vllm_ascend.ops  # noqa: F401 - Break the device_op import cycle.
+
+# Typical A2/A3 GDN prefill shape.
+BATCH = 1
+TOKENS = 64
+HK = 16
+HV = 32
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+STATE_SLOTS = 2
+CHUNK64_INDICES = (0, 0, 1, 0)
+
+
+def make_meta(cu_seqlens=(0, 32, 64), keep_meta=None, cu_seqlens_kern=None):
+    """Build the subset of GDNChunkedPrefillMetadata the adaptor reads."""
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens,
+        cu_seqlens_kern=cu_seqlens_kern,
+        chunk_indices_chunk64_host=CHUNK64_INDICES,
+        keep_meta=keep_meta,
+    )
+
+
+def make_inputs(tokens=TOKENS, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    """Build contract-shaped q/k/v/g/beta tensors, all sequence-major."""
+    q = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype)
+    k = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype)
+    v = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype)
+    g = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype)
+    beta = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, dtype=dtype)
+    return q, k, v, g, beta
+
+
+def make_state(slots=STATE_SLOTS, dtype=torch.bfloat16, fill=5.0):
+    """Recurrent state in the caller's [N, Hv, Dk, Dv] layout."""
+    return torch.full((slots, HV, HEAD_DIM, HEAD_DIM), fill, dtype=dtype)
+
+
+class TestFlaGdnPrefillAdaptor(TestCase):
+    """Verify BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill forwards the kernel contract."""
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 1. Kernel contract: all parameters match the A2/A3 optimized path.  #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_forwards_the_kernel_contract_for_sequence_major_inputs(self):
+        """BSND layout, all kwargs matching the optimized A2/A3 contract."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        q, k, v, g, beta = make_inputs()
+        state = make_state()
+        calls = []
+
+        def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, **kwargs):
+            calls.append({"q": q_in, "k": k_in, "v": v_in, "g": g_in, "beta": beta_in, **kwargs})
+            return torch.zeros_like(q_in), torch.zeros_like(state)
+
+        BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, g, beta, state, 0.125, make_meta(), fused_fwd)
+        call = calls[0]
+
+        self.assertEqual(call["chunk_size"], 64)
+        self.assertFalse(call["use_exp2"])
+        self.assertTrue(call["use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel"])
+        # fused_gdn_gating already emits sigmoid(beta), so re-applying it in the
+        # kernel would double-sigmoid the values.
+        self.assertFalse(call["use_beta_sigmoid_in_kernel"])
+        self.assertFalse(call["disable_recompute"])
+        self.assertTrue(call["state_v_first"])
+        self.assertFalse(call["allow_neg_eigval"])
+        self.assertTrue(call["output_final_state"])
+        self.assertEqual(call["layout"], "BSND")
+        self.assertEqual(call["scale"], 0.125)
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 2. Layout selection: BNSD when head-first transpose is contiguous. #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_head_first_contiguous_uses_bnsd_without_copying(self):
+        """When q/k/v transpose(1,2) is contiguous, use BNSD and pass the view."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        tokens = 32
+        # Create contiguous BSND tensors whose transpose(1,2) is also contiguous.
+        q = torch.randn(BATCH, HK, tokens, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(1, 2)
+        k = torch.randn(BATCH, HK, tokens, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(1, 2)
+        v = torch.randn(BATCH, HV, tokens, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(1, 2)
+
+        calls = []
+
+        def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(kwargs)
+            for actual in (q_in, k_in, v_in):
+                self.assertTrue(actual.is_contiguous())
+            return torch.zeros_like(q_in), torch.zeros_like(v_in)
+
+        gate = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        raw_beta = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, gate, raw_beta, make_state(), 0.125, make_meta(), fused_fwd)
+        self.assertEqual(calls[0]["layout"], "BNSD")
+
+    def test_non_contiguous_transpose_uses_bsnd(self):
+        """When the head-first transpose is NOT contiguous, fall back to BSND."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        tokens = 64
+        # A slice breaks contiguity after transpose(1,2).
+        q = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens * 2, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[:, :tokens]
+        k = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens * 2, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[:, :tokens]
+        v = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens * 2, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[:, :tokens]
+
+        calls = []
+
+        def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(kwargs)
+            for actual in (q_in, k_in, v_in):
+                self.assertTrue(actual.is_contiguous())
+            return torch.zeros_like(q_in), torch.zeros_like(v_in)
+
+        gate = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        raw_beta = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, gate, raw_beta, make_state(), 0.125, make_meta(), fused_fwd)
+        self.assertEqual(calls[0]["layout"], "BSND")
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 3. State passthrough: state_v_first=True, no transpose, no copy.   #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_recurrent_state_is_passed_through_untransposed(self):
+        """initial_state must reach the kernel as-is (state_v_first=True)."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        state = make_state(fill=7.0)
+        original_ptr = state.data_ptr()
+
+        calls = []
+
+        def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(kwargs)
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["initial_state"].data_ptr(), original_ptr)
+            return torch.zeros_like(q_in), kwargs["initial_state"].clone()
+
+        q, k, v, g, beta = make_inputs()
+        output, final = BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, g, beta, state, 0.125, make_meta(), fused_fwd)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(final, state))
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 4. keep_meta: scatter kept segments, preserve empty ones.           #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_keep_meta_scatters_kept_segments_and_preserves_empty_ones(self):
+        """When keep_meta filters empty segments, only kept rows reach kernel."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        keep = torch.tensor([False, True, False, True, False])
+        meta = make_meta(
+            cu_seqlens=(0, 0, 33, 33, 98, 98),
+            keep_meta=keep,
+            cu_seqlens_kern=(0, 33, 98),
+        )
+        state = make_state(slots=5, fill=3.0)
+        original_state = state.clone()
+
+        tokens = 98
+        q = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        k = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HK, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        v = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        gate = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        raw_beta = torch.randn(BATCH, tokens, HV, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        kernel_final = torch.full_like(state[[1, 3]], 99.0)
+
+        def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, **kwargs):
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["cu_seqlens"], (0, 33, 98))
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["initial_state"].shape[0], 2)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(kwargs["initial_state"], original_state[[1, 3]])
+            return torch.zeros_like(q_in), kernel_final
+
+        output, final = BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, gate, raw_beta, state, 0.125, meta, fused_fwd)
+
+        expected = original_state.clone()
+        expected[[1, 3]] = 99.0
+        torch.testing.assert_close(final, expected)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(final[~keep], state[~keep])
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 5. Dtype casting: g → float32, beta → v.dtype.                     #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_g_and_beta_are_cast_to_the_kernel_dtypes(self):
+        """beta/g may arrive as bf16 or fp32; kernel always sees fp32 g and bf16 beta."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        for g_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            for beta_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+                with self.subTest(g_dtype=g_dtype, beta_dtype=beta_dtype):
+                    q, k, v, _, _ = make_inputs()
+                    g = torch.randn(BATCH, TOKENS, HV, HEAD_DIM, dtype=g_dtype)
+                    beta = torch.randn(BATCH, TOKENS, HV, dtype=beta_dtype)
+
+                    calls: list[Any] = []
+
+                    def fused_fwd(q_in, k_in, v_in, g_in, beta_in, _calls=calls, **kwargs):
+                        _calls.append({"g": g_in, "beta": beta_in})
+                        return torch.zeros_like(q_in), torch.zeros_like(v_in)
+
+                    BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(q, k, v, g, beta, make_state(), 0.125, make_meta(), fused_fwd)
+
+                    self.assertEqual(calls[0]["g"].dtype, torch.float32)
+                    self.assertEqual(calls[0]["beta"].dtype, v.dtype)
+                    self.assertTrue(calls[0]["g"].is_contiguous())
+                    self.assertTrue(calls[0]["beta"].is_contiguous())
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 6. Layer reuse: the same prebuilt metadata is reused across layers. #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_layers_reuse_exact_prebuilt_object(self):
+        """Verify the adaptor does not rebuild chunk descriptors per layer."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        meta = make_meta()
+        indices = meta.chunk_indices_chunk64_host
+        effective = meta.cu_seqlens_host
+
+        tokens = TOKENS
+        state = make_state()
+        seen: list[Any] = []
+
+        def fused(q, k, v, g, beta, indices=indices, effective=effective, seen=seen, tokens=tokens, **kwargs):
+            self.assertIs(kwargs["chunk_indices"], indices)
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["cu_seqlens"], effective)
+            seen.append(kwargs["chunk_indices"])
+            return torch.zeros(1, tokens, 2, 4), kwargs["initial_state"].clone()
+
+        for _ in range(3):
+            _, final = BaseDeviceAdaptor.fla_gdn_prefill(
+                torch.zeros(1, tokens, 1, 4),
+                torch.zeros(1, tokens, 1, 4),
+                torch.zeros(1, tokens, 2, 4),
+                torch.zeros(1, tokens, 2),

+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(final, state))

+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    # 7. Full integration: compacted state scatter + layout + dtype.     #
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
+    def test_compacted_state_scatter_and_layout(self):
+        """End-to-end: keep_meta scatter, BSND layout, beta passthrough."""
+        from vllm_ascend.device.device_op import BaseDeviceAdaptor
+
+        keep = torch.tensor([False, True, False, True, False])

+            cu_seqlens_kern=(0, 33, 98),

+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["cu_seqlens"], (0, 33, 98))

+
+

[BugFix] Revert the CODEOWNERS empty-file blob-size check that hangs ci-gate (#22868)

## What this PR does / why we need it?

Reverts ac7c428adb (#22662) to unhang the ci-gate "CODEOWNERS coverage
check" step, which has been running for hours on every gate run since
that change landed (e.g. run
[45114337341](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/45114337341/job/137512029083);
multiple PRs affected, 360-minute timeout never reached).

Root cause: #22662 assumed actions/checkout still fetches every blob
under `sparse-checkout`. It does not — checkout applies
`--filter=blob:none` automatically whenever `sparse-checkout` is set
([git-source-provider.ts](https://github.com/actions/checkout/blob/main/src/git-source-provider.ts)),
so blobs outside `.github/` are absent. `git ls-tree -r --long HEAD`
must report each blob's size and triggers a lazy promisor fetch per
missing blob (~4k round trips). Reproduced locally with a `blob:none`
partial clone: 30 s and <20% of entries listed; with a full fetch the
same command takes 0.03 s.

Why revert instead of a targeted fix: dropping the sparse checkout (full
depth-1 checkout, ~200 MiB transfer) also fixes it, but the revert is
the minimal safe step — the only regression is that empty `__init__.py`
files are again reported as non-blocking `::warning` coverage noise in
CI, which we lived with before #22662. A partial-clone-safe exemption
can be designed separately.

## Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. CI-only; unblocks the merge gate for all open PRs whose coverage
check is stuck.

## How was this patch tested?

- Root cause reproduced locally (see above); revert restores the
pre-#22662 code path that ran in CI for days without hanging.
- CI testing only for the real gate job — after merge, the stuck gate
jobs need cancel + re-run.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

[Performance] Tile DCP rank reduction on A2/A3 (#19555)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

DCP A2A combines one attention-output contribution and its log-sum-exp
(LSE) from each context-parallel rank, plus an optional local FIA
contribution. For BF16, each received row contains D output values and
four packed LSE values; receive layout is [DCP ranks, local heads,
tokens, D+4], and result layout is [tokens, local heads, D]. The scalar
kernel visits ranks serially for each row. This PR adds an A2/A3
rank-tiled path that computes the same LSE-weighted result across ranks
and feature tiles. This PR contains only the DCP/Triton optimization;
MoERunner.forward override removal is independently reviewed in #20248.
The DCP branch was rebased through main `6924c0889` and remains
independent of the MoE PR. The interfaces, layouts and A5 batched
pack/combine implementation from #17387 are retained. No HCCL collective
or four-lane LSE wire-format change.

The earlier DCP16/D512/T>=16 dispatch described measured shapes, not a
general crossover. This revision selects by rank reduction, feature
tiling and total work instead:

- BF16, head scatter, a local FIA contribution and contiguous local
features;
- `4 <= R <= 16`, `Rtile = next_power_of_2(R)`;
- `F = min(128, next_power_of_2(D), 2048 // Rtile)`;
- `R >= 2 * ceil(D / F)` to amortize repeated LSE loads;
- `T * H >= max(ceil(4 * vector_cores / R), ceil(vector_cores / ceil(D /
F)))` to provide enough work.

The work thresholds and rank range were selected from A3 measurements;
cross-device speedups are not established. Rank and feature tails are
masked. Feature-strided local inputs retain the scalar fallback because
their measured tiling regression remains relevant. A5 uses the main
batched/scalar paths; the rank-tiled kernel is disabled on A5.
Unsupported types, layouts, small work and other rank counts retain
existing paths. Related tracking: #19663.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Lower eligible DCP merge overhead without new configuration or host
transfers. The shared dispatch can be reached from decode and
chunked-prefill callers; measurements in this PR cover Kimi-K3 decode
only, and no prefill speedup is claimed. Parallel FP32 summation changes
the reduction order and can cross BF16 rounding boundaries compared with
the scalar FMA loop. It is not claimed bitwise equivalent to the old
reduction.

### How was this patch tested?

#### Current-main operator validation (2026-10-28)

A3, original `nightly-main-a3-openeuler-20261021174845` image, torch
2.10 / torch_npu 2.10.post4, private CANN 9.2 overlay, one device in an
isolated two-NPU task; no model service. Benchmark code loads this PR's
Triton kernels and current-main scalar source. The operator harness uses
the existing vLLM `a98247ab` runtime; final source tests use main's
verified vLLM `544f182d`.

The matrix completed 72 synthetic cases. Its first 64 span R=2/4/8/16,
D=96/256/512/1024, T=1/4/16/64 and local H=4. An initial occupancy-only
rule exposed regressions (DCP4/D512-T64 1.174x, DCP4/D1024-T64 1.913x,
DCP8/D1024-T64 1.347x). The final work-based rule excludes these
regions.

Twenty timed cases remain selected by the final rule, with
candidate/baseline ratios **0.237–0.860**. Each case used ABBA graph
captures **within one process**, five warmups and three samples of 100
replays per block. Both arms execute on the same A3 device; a
dispatch-only device-type override selects main's scalar kernel for the
baseline. The final selector is a strict subset of the initial measured
selector; tiled kernel math is unchanged. Samples are not independent
end-to-end A/B pairs.

| R | D | T | Local H | Scalar µs | Tiled µs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 256 | 16 | 4 | 25.216 | 20.244 |
| 8 | 512 | 16 | 4 | 33.890 | 24.693 |
| 16 | 512 | 4 | 4 | 25.644 | 21.585 |
| 16 | 512 | 16 | 4 | 51.770 | 28.058 |
| 16 | 1024 | 16 | 4 | 57.153 | 36.276 |

Eight additional DCP32 small-head cases completed, but the current-main
scalar DCP32/D512 compilation exceeded six minutes and was stopped.
**DCP32 is not enabled**; this is an incomplete qualification, not a
successful full DCP32 sweep.

Final-source validation of the earlier A3 implementation: 28 device
tests passed against an independent FP64 oracle, including
non-power-of-two rank/feature tails, invalid contributions,
feature-strided fallback and graph replay. The rank-tiled kernel is
unchanged by the cross-device dispatch update. The selector
simplification removes the inactive minimum feature width and folds the
two work tests into one equivalent minimum-row calculation. All 64
measured DCP2/4/8/16 matrix shapes choose the same path before and after
this simplification.

Current dispatch follow-up (2026-10-30): removed the A3 device guard and
gave A5's existing batched combine priority. The zero-NPU suite passed
**54/54** cases covering A2/A3/A5 branch selection, work bounds and A5
overlap. Ruff check/format, Python compilation and diff whitespace
checks passed. The published kernel has A3 device correctness and
operator timing evidence; A2/A5 device correctness and performance have
not been measured for this follow-up. Device CI can exercise those paths
when authorized.

#### Historical joint MoE + DCP measurements (not standalone DCP
evidence)

The following measurements belong to the earlier joint MoE + DCP
candidate. They are retained as provenance and **cannot be attributed to
standalone DCP rank tiling or to the separate MoE PR**. They are not a
fresh end-to-end measurement of this dispatch or current main.

A3, private CANN 9.2 runtime, Kimi-K3 W4A8, P=PP4TP16,
D=DP4TP16DCP16/EP64, AIV, DSpark7, max length 1M. Each arm uses the same
12 long-context prompts (approximately 34k–115k input tokens), 512
output tokens/request, seed 1024, temperature/top_p=1, a full workload
warmup, and cache resets. Only Decode source changes; Prefill/proxy
remain fixed. Every completed timed run has 12 successes, zero failures,
and 6144 output tokens.

| Pair | Concurrency | Baseline median TPOT | Candidate median TPOT |
Improvement | Throughput change | p90 change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1/B1 | 1 | 25.785 ms | 24.324 ms | 5.66% | -1.38% | +1.54% |
| A2/B2 (reverse order) | 1 | 25.042 ms | 24.652 ms | 1.56% | +0.98% |
-3.52% |
| A1/B1 | 8 | 27.171 ms | 25.750 ms | 5.23% | +0.15% | -10.81% |
| A2/B2 (reverse order) | 8 | 27.251 ms | 25.155 ms | 7.69% | -0.38% |
+1.37% |

The final B3 measurement was stopped at the author’s request; it is
excluded from this table. Two completed matched pairs are reported. C1
improvements vary; these results do not establish a uniform 3% gain.
Consecutive same-process B1/B2 TPOT variation is 1.34% at C1 and 2.34%
at C8.

Historical distributed DCP tests covered 16 ranks × three shapes × 12
changing-input replays. Existing baseline model-quality evidence is
CEval 95.90 and PIQA 97.06; those are baseline scores, not fresh
candidate scores. MoE override removal and its isolated add profiling
have moved to #20248. No standalone service TPOT gain is claimed for
either split PR.

### Contributor self-check

**Function and scope.** The input/output contract is described above.
Dispatch requires BF16, head scatter, a local FIA contribution,
contiguous local features, DCP 4–16 and sufficient rank/feature work. It
does not change HCCL exchange or packed LSE format. A5 uses the main
batched/scalar paths; rank tiling is disabled on A5.

**Precision and coverage.** On A3, 28 NPU cases passed an independent
FP64 reference (FP32 rtol=1e-4/atol=1e-5) and checked exact BF16
rounding from the same FP32 result. Coverage includes R=4/8/12/16,
D=96/130/160/256/512/1024, T=1/4/16/64, H=4/6, contiguous and
feature-strided local inputs, mixed local dtypes, invalid/all-invalid
LSE and graph replay. The 54 zero-NPU tests cover dispatch boundaries
and A5 fallback. Candidate model-level GPQA/GSM8K accuracy has not been
run; historical CEval/PIQA results are baseline-only.

**Single-op performance.** Same-process A3 ABBA graph captures, five
warmups and three 100-replay samples per arm. Unit is microseconds;
baseline is current-main scalar combine. The final dispatch-selected
20-shape subset is shown below. Candidate/baseline ratios are
0.237–0.860. The separate historical MoE+DCP model run below is not
attributable to this PR; no fresh model-level GPQA/GSM8K performance
result is claimed.

| R | D | T | H | Scalar | Rank-tiled | Ratio |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 96 | 16 | 4 | 22.210 | 16.679 | 0.751 |
| 4 | 96 | 64 | 4 | 38.736 | 25.828 | 0.667 |
| 4 | 256 | 16 | 4 | 25.216 | 20.244 | 0.803 |

**Silent changes and recompilation.** The diff is limited to DCP combine
code and tests; there are no host-side, communication or API changes.
DCP size, head dimension and tile sizes remain compile-time
specializations; token count and local-head count are runtime scalars
with Triton value specialization disabled. An A3 black-box cache sweep
over T=4/8/16/32/64/128 produced **one in-memory JIT cache variant and
one compile** for fixed R=16, D=512, H=4. Before this fix, the same

+
+Eligible BF16 head-scatter shapes with a contiguous local contribution may use the rank-tiled kernel ahead of the batched path. Its parallel FP32 reduction can round differently from the scalar kernel. The rank tile uses one 16x512 BF16 tile per job, so the FP32 temporaries stay at 32 KiB. It requires a compile-time rank-row stride to vectorize; with runtime head/token counts A3 lowered it to scalar-rate transfers and ran far slower than the scalar kernel.
+
+Device routing:
+
+- **A5**: the dynamic kernel is used for DCP8/DCP16 with head dims 512 and 1024, where it measured 2.1-3.9x faster than the scalar and batched paths on the operator (including T64/T256). On a real 8-rank HCCL run the combine fell from 6.18/7.64/12.33/21.67us to 3.45/4.73/6.90/11.67us at T4/T16/T16-H6/T64, while the all-to-all stayed near 53us.
+- **A3**: the dynamic kernel is never selected. Instead, warmup compiles a static twin (`NUM_HEADS`/`NUM_TOKENS` constexpr) for the engine's ACLGraph capture sizes (falling back to the #16350 decode budget `[1,2,4,8,16,32,48,64,96,128,192]`), and the dispatcher uses it only when the exact `(heads, tokens, head_dim, dcp, local strides, lse strides)` signature was warmed. Decode batches are padded to those graph sizes, so normal serving stays on the static kernel. Prefill token counts and any unwarmed signature fall back to the scalar/batched path with a one-time log instead of compiling inside a request. A3 DCP16 measured 2.0-2.2x faster than scalar/batched at D512 and 1.35x at D1024; DCP8 measured 1.40x at T16.
+
+Requests with `return_lse=True` always keep the scalar kernel because neither rank-tiled kernel writes the LSE lane.
+
+Warmup keys accumulate across target/draft warmup passes; a candidate that produced no launch is never installed, so a missed bucket can only fall back, not compile.

[CI] Verify accuracy against the lower bound only by default (#22679)

## What this PR does / why we need it?

Flips the default accuracy verification mode from `range` (baseline ±
threshold) to `ge` (lower bound only), per the team review decision that
accuracy above the upper bound should no longer fail a case.

Motivating incidents where a *good* result was rejected by the range
check:

- `MiniMax-M3-BF16-A3` nightly (run 42635289613): gsm8k-lite measured
100.0 vs baseline 95 / threshold 2 -> failed because 100 > 97.
- `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-w8a8-PD-MRV2`: GPQA measured 93.43 vs baseline 88
/ threshold 5 -> failed because 93.43 > 93.

With `ge` as the default, both cases pass (results only improve), while
regressions below the baseline still fail.

Behavior:
- `verify_mode` defaults to `ge`: accuracy must be >= `baseline`. Values
above `baseline + threshold` pass but log an info-level re-baselining
hint so owners can update stale baselines.
- `verify_mode: range` remains available for cases that intentionally
need an upper bound (e.g. detecting response collapse); set it
explicitly in the case YAML.

## Related issues

Team review decision (2026-11-20): accuracy exceeding the upper bound
will no longer be verified.

## Test cases passed

- Syntax check on `tools/aisbench.py` passes; logic self-check confirms:
100.0 vs [93, 97] now passes with a re-baseline hint, 91.0 still fails,
93.43 vs [83, 93] now passes.
- All 97 existing accuracy-bearing case YAMLs are unaffected except that
upper-bound-only failures disappear; the one existing explicit
`verify_mode: "ge"` case (310P textvqa) behaves identically.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

-msgstr "| `/run` | PR 作者，或拥有仓库 triage 及以上权限的用户 |"
+"- If an E2E run for the head commit is already queued or in progress, `/run` is a no-op.\n"

+"  already verified, so push a new commit if the code changed.\n"
+"- If that newest run **finished without passing**, `/run` refuses as well and points\n"
+"  to `/rerun`, which retries only the failed jobs on that same commit and is much\n"
+"  cheaper than the full matrix. A `cancelled` run is not treated as a verdict on the\n"
+"  code, so such a commit can still be tested with `/run`."

+"- 如果该最新运行**已结束但未通过**，`/run` 同样会拒绝，并指向 `/rerun`，后者只重试同一 commit 上失败的作业，比运行完整矩阵要节省得多。`cancelled` 的运行不会被视为对代码的判定结果，因此这样的 commit 仍可通过 `/run` 进行测试。"

+msgid "## Overview"
+msgstr "## 概述"
+
+msgid "!!! warning \"GQA DCP Support Removed\""
+msgstr "!!! warning \"GQA DCP 支持已移除\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Decode Context Parallelism (DCP) for GQA models has been removed. GQA draft "
+"models maintain native TP sharding under target DCP. DCP for MLA and SFA "
+"models remains fully supported. See [RFC #21305](https://github.com/vllm-"
+"project/vllm-ascend/issues/21305)."
+msgstr ""
+"GQA 模型的解码上下文并行（DCP）已被移除。GQA 草稿模型在目标 DCP 下保持原生 TP 分片。MLA 和 SFA 模型的 DCP "
+"仍完全支持。参见 [RFC #21305](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-"
+"ascend/issues/21305)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"MLA and SFA implement both stacked layouts. GQA/MQA supports PCP only and "
+"must use `DCP=1`. DSA and DSA V4.1 PCP use replicated caches, with DCP "
+"stacking outside their documented PCP configuration. With PCP=1, DCP groups "
+"lie within TP: MLA requires `TP % DCP == 0`, sparse SFA requires `DCP == TP`"
+" when DCP is enabled. Deployment constraints are listed in the [Context "
+"Parallel user guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"MLA 和 SFA 实现了两种堆叠布局。GQA/MQA 仅支持 PCP，且必须使用 `DCP=1`。DSA 和 DSA V4.1 PCP "
+"使用复制缓存，DCP 堆叠在其文档所述的 PCP 配置之外。当 PCP=1 时，DCP 组位于 TP 之内：MLA 要求 `TP % DCP == "
+"0`，稀疏 SFA 在启用 DCP 时要求 `DCP == "
+"TP`。部署约束列于[上下文并行用户指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `DCPMetadataBuilderMixin` owns DCP group/rank discovery.\n"
+"- `DCPImplMixin` owns DCP collectives and the common partial-output/LSE merge.\n"
+"- MLA and SFA DCP builders inherit their v1 metadata builders. They only add DCP metadata fields or temporarily expose the DCP-specific cache view.\n"
+"- MLA and SFA DCP implementations inherit their v1 implementations and override only the kernel stages whose communication or cache layout differs."
+msgstr ""
+"- `DCPMetadataBuilderMixin` 负责 DCP 组/rank 发现。\n"
+"- `DCPImplMixin` 负责 DCP 集合通信以及通用的部分输出/LSE 合并。\n"
+"- MLA 和 SFA 的 DCP 构建器继承其 v1 元数据构建器。它们仅添加 DCP 元数据字段或临时暴露 DCP 专用的缓存视图。\n"
+"- MLA 和 SFA 的 DCP 实现继承其 v1 实现，仅重写通信或缓存布局不同的内核阶段。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- MLA gathers the context KV cache, restores request-contiguous order, and "
+"computes attention for the current query chunk."
+msgstr "- MLA 收集上下文 KV 缓存，恢复请求连续顺序，并为当前查询块计算注意力。"
+
+msgid ""
+"PCP-only GQA and MLA gather current K/V or latent KV for cache insertion "
+"while computing local queries. With PCP+DCP, MLA gathers history KV in "
+"bounded chunks; senders derive a shared plan from the global batch so "
+"differing local fragment lengths produce matching collective sizes."
+msgstr ""
+"仅使用 PCP 的 GQA 和 MLA 在计算本地查询的同时，收集当前 K/V 或潜在 KV 以插入缓存。使用 PCP+DCP 时，MLA "
+"以有界分块收集历史 KV；发送方从全局批次推导共享计划，使不同的本地片段长度产生匹配的集合通信大小。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **Weight sharding:** Embedding and LM-head weights can be partitioned across TP×PCP. Supported SFA/DSA O-projections also use PCP weight shards: prefill can gather weights temporarily, while sharded decode exchanges activations and returns projected results to their owners. See the [PCP weight-sharding configuration](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md#usage) for the embedding, LM-head, and O-projection options.\n"
+"- **Graph execution:** Local execution sizes and global batch metadata coexist. Input, slot, and restore buffers keep stable addresses across replay, and capture metadata must describe the runtime layouts. See [ACL Graph](ACL_Graph.md) for replay mechanisms and the CP user guide for supported modes.\n"
+"- **Speculative decoding:** The target uses its PCP topology; supported draft paths run with logical PCP=1 on each peer. Target outputs are restored for draft processing and sampling. MLA/SFA drafts retain their supported DCP topology; GQA drafts use DCP=1, with TP-local heads and a complete sequence cache on every DCP rank.\n"
+"- **KV transfer:** In the documented PCP P/D setup, the producer uses PCP and the consumer uses PCP=1. For standalone DCP and PCP+DCP, KV transfer requires `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size` to be set explicitly to the cache block size."
+msgstr ""
+"- **权重的分片：** Embedding 和 LM-head 权重可以跨 TP×PCP 进行分区。支持的 SFA/DSA O-projection 也使用 PCP 权重分片：prefill 可以临时收集权重，而分片的 decode 交换激活并将投影结果返回给其所有者。有关 embedding、LM-head 和 O-projection 选项，请参见 [PCP 权重分片配置](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md#usage)。\n"
+"- **图执行：** 本地执行大小和全局批次元数据共存。输入、槽位和恢复缓冲区在重放期间保持稳定地址，捕获元数据必须描述运行时布局。有关重放机制，请参见 [ACL Graph](ACL_Graph.md)；有关支持的模式，请参见 CP 用户指南。\n"
+"- **投机解码：** 目标使用其 PCP 拓扑；支持的草稿路径在每个对等节点上以逻辑 PCP=1 运行。目标输出会被恢复以用于草稿处理和采样。MLA/SFA 草稿保留其支持的 DCP 拓扑；GQA 草稿使用 DCP=1，在每个 DCP rank 上具有 TP 本地头和完整序列缓存。\n"
+"- **KV 传输：** 在文档所述的 PCP P/D 设置中，生产者使用 PCP，消费者使用 PCP=1。对于独立 DCP 和 PCP+DCP，KV 传输要求将 `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size` 显式设置为缓存块大小。"
+

 msgid ""
 "### 17. How to troubleshoot and resolve size capture failures resulting from"

 msgstr "### 17. 如何排查和解决因流资源耗尽导致的尺寸捕获失败问题，其根本原因是什么？"
 
-msgid ""
-"1. Upgrade to a newer HDK/CANN stack if one is available for your environment. Recent releases improve ACL graph capacity, so older workarounds may no longer be necessary.\n"
-"2. Manually reduce the configured graph sizes, for example: '{\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\":[size1, size2, size3, ...]}', or lower `max_cudagraph_capture_size`.\n"
-"3. If your workload is mostly uniform decode, try ACLGraph's `FULL` or `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` mode instead of the `PIECEWISE`.\n"
-"4. If you use `PIECEWISE` or `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` and still hit this failure after upgrading, set `cudagraph_capture_sizes` manually according to your real workload and reduce the configured coverage.\n"
-"5. If you are debugging a startup failure, temporarily disable graph mode (`cudagraph_mode=\"NONE\"` / `enforce_eager=True`) to confirm the issue is capture-related."
-msgstr ""
-"1. 如果您的环境中有可用的新版 HDK/CANN 栈，请升级到该版本。最新版本改进了 ACL 图的容量，因此旧的解决方法可能不再需要。\n"
-"2. 手动减小配置的图大小，例如：'{\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\":[size1, size2, size3, ...]}'，或降低 `max_cudagraph_capture_size`。\n"
-"3. 如果您的负载主要是均匀的解码，请尝试使用 ACLGraph 的 `FULL` 或 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 模式，而不是 `PIECEWISE`。\n"
-"4. 如果您使用 `PIECEWISE` 或 `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`，并且在升级后仍然遇到此失败，请根据您的实际工作负载手动设置 `cudagraph_capture_sizes` 并减少配置的覆盖范围。\n"
-"5. 如果您正在调试启动失败，请临时禁用图模式（`cudagraph_mode=\"NONE\"` / `enforce_eager=True`）以确认问题是否与捕获相关。"

 "When testing a vLLM server, one may find that TPOT increases as concurrency increases (for example, TPOT increases by 0.5 ~ 1ms when concurrency increases by 4). This phenomenon is normal in most cases. However, sometimes TPOT may increase dramatically (10 to 100ms for example) as concurrency grows. This is possibly caused by [**PREEMPTION**](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/optimization/#preemption) in vLLM.\n"
 "Generally, when your server hits KV cache limits, vLLM tries to free KV cache of requests to ensure sufficient space for other requests, which is called preemption in vLLM. When a request is preempted, the default behavior is to recompute the KV cache of this request again in the future, which is why the performance might drop significantly. -msgid ""
-"- `--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager` keeps the hybrid KV cache manager enabled. DeepSeek-V4 KV Pool deployments require this flag; otherwise, the service may OOM during startup.\n"
-"- `--enforce-eager` forces eager execution on prefill nodes instead of graph compilation.\n"
-"- `--trust-remote-code` allows the model repository's custom code to be loaded. Only use trusted model repositories.\n"
-"- `--kv-transfer-config` configures KV cache transfer between the prefill producer and decode consumer in PD separation.\n"
-"- `kv_connector_extra_config.prefill.dp_size/tp_size` and `decode.dp_size/tp_size` must match the actual parallel layout on the prefill and decode sides.\n"
-"- `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable: true`: enables the recomputation scheduler. When the KV Cache of the Decode node is insufficient, requests are sent to Prefill for KV Cache recomputation. Enable it only on PD Decode nodes; the legacy top-level key is deprecated.\n"
-"- `--speculative-config`: Prefill and Decode must use the same DSpark `num_speculative_tokens` value. Use the value declared by the checkpoint; the 950DT and A3 examples use `5`, while the A2 example uses `7`. The nested `enforce_eager` applies to DSpark draft execution, while the top-level `--enforce-eager` keeps the Prefill target model in eager mode.\n"
-"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` enables the extended NPU graph mode on Decode for graph compilation (Prefill runs eager mode instead); `enable_static_kernel: false` keeps dynamic-shape kernels instead of static-shape kernels for aclgraph execution.\n"
-"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size` configures prefill context parallelism (PCP) on Model Runner V2 (MRv2), replacing the DSA-CP configuration used on MRv1. Besides speeding up long-context prefill, enabling PCP also shards the o_proj weights across the PCP group, providing partial tensor parallelism even when `--tensor-parallel-size` is `1` and relieving memory pressure. Each hardware tab configures PCP differently; see the tab-specific descriptions.\n"
-"- `--quantization ascend` enables Ascend quantization for the W4A8 model used in the A2 and A3 configurations. The original DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 weights used on 950DT products do not require this option."

-"- `--enforce-eager` 强制 prefill 节点使用 eager 执行，而非图编译。\n"
-"- `--trust-remote-code` 允许加载模型仓库中的自定义代码。请仅使用可信的模型仓库。\n"

-"- `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable: true`：启用重计算调度器。当 Decode 节点的 KV Cache 不足时，请求会被发送到 Prefill 进行 KV Cache 重计算。仅在 PD Decode 节点上启用；旧的顶层键已弃用。\n"
-"- `--speculative-config`：Prefill 和 Decode 必须使用相同的 DSpark `num_speculative_tokens` 值。请使用 checkpoint 声明的值；950DT 和 A3 示例使用 `5`，而 A2 示例使用 `7`。嵌套的 `enforce_eager` 作用于 DSpark draft 执行，而顶层的 `--enforce-eager` 使 Prefill 目标模型保持 eager 模式。\n"
-"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` 在 Decode 侧启用扩展 NPU 图模式进行图编译（Prefill 则运行 eager 模式）；`enable_static_kernel: false` 保持动态 shape kernel，而非用于 aclgraph 执行的静态 shape kernel。\n"
-"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 在 Model Runner V2（MRv2）上配置 prefill 上下文并行（PCP），替代 MRv1 上使用的 DSA-CP 配置。启用 PCP 除了加速长上下文 prefill 外，还会在 PCP 组内分片 o_proj 权重，即使 `--tensor-parallel-size` 为 `1` 也能提供部分张量并行，从而缓解内存压力。各硬件标签页对 PCP 的配置方式不同，请参阅各标签页的说明。\n"
-"- `--quantization ascend` 为 A2 和 A3 配置中使用的 W4A8 模型启用昇腾量化。950DT 系列产品上使用的原始 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 权重不需要此选项。"

+"(`--dp-address` above, e.g. `xx.xx.xx.5`) as the IP of Decode node 0."

+"节点暴露 `8000` 到 `8007` 端口。请使用 DP 主地址（即上文的 `--dp-address`，例如 `xx.xx.xx.5`）作为 "
+"Decode 节点 0 的 IP。"

+"the P-D disaggregation proxy."
+msgstr ""
+"请参考 [Prefill-Decode "
+"分离（DeepSeek）](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md) 部署 P-D "

+
+msgid ""
+"- `--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager` keeps the hybrid KV cache manager enabled. DeepSeek-V4 KV Pool deployments require this flag; otherwise, the service may OOM during startup.\n"
+"- `--enforce-eager` forces eager execution on prefill nodes instead of graph compilation.\n"
+"- `--trust-remote-code` allows the model repository's custom code to be loaded. Only use trusted model repositories.\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config` configures KV cache transfer between the prefill producer and decode consumer in PD separation.\n"
+"- `kv_connector_extra_config.prefill.dp_size/tp_size` and `decode.dp_size/tp_size` must match the actual parallel layout on the prefill and decode sides.\n"
+"- `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable: true`: enables the recomputation scheduler. When the KV Cache of the Decode node is insufficient, requests are sent to Prefill for KV Cache recomputation. Enable it only on PD Decode nodes; the legacy top-level key is deprecated.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`: Prefill and Decode must use the same DSpark `num_speculative_tokens` value. Use the value declared by the checkpoint; the 950DT and A3 examples use `5`, while the A2 example uses `7`. The nested `enforce_eager` applies to DSpark draft execution, while the top-level `--enforce-eager` keeps the Prefill target model in eager mode.\n"
+"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` enables the extended NPU graph mode on Decode for graph compilation (Prefill runs eager mode instead); `enable_static_kernel: false` keeps dynamic-shape kernels instead of static-shape kernels for ACL graph execution.\n"
+"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size` configures prefill context parallelism (PCP) on Model Runner V2 (MRv2), replacing the DSA-CP configuration used on MRv1. Besides speeding up long-context prefill, enabling PCP also shards the o_proj weights across the PCP group, providing partial tensor parallelism even when `--tensor-parallel-size` is `1` and relieving memory pressure. Each hardware tab configures PCP differently; see the tab-specific descriptions.\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend` enables Ascend quantization for the W4A8 model used in the A2 and A3 configurations. The original DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 weights used on 950DT products do not require this option."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager` 保持混合 KV cache 管理器处于启用状态。DeepSeek-V4 KV Pool 部署需要此标志；否则服务可能在启动期间出现 OOM。\n"
+"- `--enforce-eager` 强制 prefill 节点使用 eager 执行，而非图编译。\n"
+"- `--trust-remote-code` 允许加载模型仓库中的自定义代码。请仅使用可信的模型仓库。\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config` 配置 PD 分离中 prefill 生产者与 decode 消费者之间的 KV cache 传输。\n"
+"- `kv_connector_extra_config.prefill.dp_size/tp_size` 和 `decode.dp_size/tp_size` 必须与 prefill 侧和 decode 侧实际的并行布局一致。\n"
+"- `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable: true`：启用重计算调度器。当 Decode 节点的 KV Cache 不足时，请求会被发送到 Prefill 进行 KV Cache 重计算。仅在 PD Decode 节点上启用；旧版顶层键已弃用。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`：Prefill 和 Decode 必须使用相同的 DSpark `num_speculative_tokens` 值。请使用 checkpoint 中声明的值；950DT 和 A3 示例使用 `5`，而 A2 示例使用 `7`。嵌套的 `enforce_eager` 作用于 DSpark draft 执行，而顶层的 `--enforce-eager` 使 Prefill 目标模型保持 eager 模式。\n"
+"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` 在 Decode 上启用扩展 NPU 图模式以进行图编译（Prefill 则运行 eager 模式）；`enable_static_kernel: false` 在 ACL 图执行中保持动态 shape kernel，而非静态 shape kernel。\n"
+"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 在 Model Runner V2（MRv2）上配置 prefill 上下文并行（PCP），替代 MRv1 上使用的 DSA-CP 配置。启用 PCP 除了加速长上下文 prefill 外，还会在 PCP 组内对 o_proj 权重进行分片，即使 `--tensor-parallel-size` 为 `1` 也能提供部分张量并行，从而缓解内存压力。各硬件标签页的 PCP 配置方式不同；请参阅各标签页的说明。\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend` 为 A2 和 A3 配置中使用的 W4A8 模型启用昇腾量化。950DT系列产品上使用的原始 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 权重不需要此选项。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After the PD separation service is fully started and every engine reports "
+"`Application startup complete`, send a request through the proxy port on the"
+" prefill master node to verify that Prefill and Decode nodes are working "
+"correctly together. Refer to [Prefill-Decode Disaggregation "

+"分离（DeepSeek）](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md)。"
+
+msgid ""

+msgid ""

+msgstr ""

+
+msgid ""
+"After the PD separation service is fully started, send a request through the"
+" proxy to verify that Prefill and Decode nodes are working correctly "

+"check the Prefill logs for Memcache lookup, get, put, and cache-hit "
+"activity, and confirm that Decode logs still show normal Prefill-to-Decode "

+msgstr ""
+"PD 分离服务完全启动后，通过代理发送请求，以验证 Prefill 和 Decode 节点能否协同正常工作。然后再次发送相同的请求以验证 KV "
+"Cache Pool：检查 Prefill 日志中的 Memcache 查找、获取、写入和缓存命中活动，并确认 Decode 日志仍显示正常的 "

+"backend)。"

+msgid "### INT8 KPool indexer cache on A3"

+
+msgid ""
+"Set `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype int8` to quantize the KPool indexer's\n"
+"queries and compressed keys to INT8. This option is independent of\n"
+"`--kv-cache-dtype`, which controls the main attention cache. The default `auto`\n"
+"and explicit `bf16` retain the BF16 indexer path."
+msgstr ""
+"设置 `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype int8` 可将 KPool indexer 的查询和压缩键量化为 "
+"INT8。该选项独立于 `--kv-cache-dtype`，后者控制主注意力缓存。默认值 `auto` 和显式指定的 `bf16` 均保留 BF16 "
+"indexer 路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The INT8 path calls `torch.ops.cann_ops_transformer.pool_key_indexer` with\n"
+"per-vector FP16 scales and requires an ops-transformer build that supports INT8\n"
+"and requests with no completed pools. The 2026-10-31 A3 CANN 9.3.0\n"
+"ops-transformer build provides this interface. Keys and scales share managed\n"
+"cache pages so cache transport includes both. No separate indexer environment\n"
+"variable is required."
+msgstr ""
+"INT8 路径会调用 `torch.ops.cann_ops_transformer.pool_key_indexer`，使用逐向量 FP16 "
+"缩放，并要求 ops-transformer 构建版本支持 INT8 以及无已完成池的请求。2026-10-31 的 A3 CANN 9.3.0 "
+"ops-transformer 构建版本提供了该接口。键和缩放共享托管缓存页，因此缓存传输会同时包含两者。无需单独设置 indexer 环境变量。"
+
+msgid "### NoPE Prolog V3"
+msgstr "### NoPE Prolog V3"
+
+msgid ""
+"On A2/A3, eligible dynamic W8A8 checkpoints automatically fuse the NoPE SFA\n"
+"projections, normalization and INT8 KV-cache write with\n"
+"`torch_npu.npu_mla_prolog_v3`. This path requires\n"
+"a torch_npu/CANN build that supports `rope_dim=0` for this operator.\n"
+"The MLA down and query-up projections must be INT8; checkpoints that keep those\n"
+"projections in BF16 retain native preprocessing. A BF16 indexer retains its original query\n"
+"projection and normalization, whose cost remains part of the layer.\n"
+"Use BF16 activations and INT8 KV cache in the serving command:"
+msgstr ""
+"在 A2/A3 上，符合条件的动态 W8A8 检查点会自动使用 `torch_npu.npu_mla_prolog_v3` 融合 NoPE SFA "
+"投影、归一化和 INT8 KV 缓存写入。该路径要求 torch_npu/CANN 构建版本支持该算子的 `rope_dim=0`。MLA down 和"
+" query-up 投影必须为 INT8；若检查点将这些投影保留为 BF16，则仍使用原生预处理。BF16 indexer "
+"会保留其原始查询投影和归一化，其开销仍属于该层的一部分。在服务命令中使用 BF16 激活和 INT8 KV 缓存："
+
+msgid ""
+"Selection applies to prefill, decode and MTP calls on eligible NoPE SFA layers.\n"
+"It requires D=256, Hckv=512 and Hcq=1536/2048. A5/MXFP8, C16, PCP, DCP and\n"

+"configuration switch is needed."
+msgstr ""

+"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` and `enable_shared_expert_dp: false` on Prefill.\n"
+"    Retain `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, `ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`\n"
+"    and `--allowed-local-media-path /` on both roles. Decode uses\n"
+"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`,\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 30`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 120`,\n"
+"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` and `enable_npugraph_ex: false`."

+"    启动器和代理。\n"
+"    两个角色均使用 EP8、FP8 主 KV 缓存和 FP8 indexer。\n"
+"    对于此池示例，在两个角色上保持 `--max-model-len 133120`、\n"
+"    `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\": 1, \"video\": 0}'` 和显式\n"
+"    `--enable-chunked-prefill`。Prefill 使用\n"
+"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=3072`、`--max-num-seqs 256`、\n"
+"    `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` 和\n"
+"    `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true`；在 Prefill 上保持 `enable_flashcomm1: false`、\n"
+"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` 和 `enable_shared_expert_dp: false`。\n"
+"    在两个角色上保留 `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`、`ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`\n"
+"    和 `--allowed-local-media-path /`。Decode 使用\n"
+"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`、\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 30`、`--max-num-batched-tokens 120`、\n"
+"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` 和 `enable_npugraph_ex: false`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep prefix caching, chunked prefill and the hybrid KV cache manager\n"
+"    enabled. With prefix caching enabled, the model configuration selects\n"
+"    `mamba_cache_mode=align`, which is required by `AscendStoreConnector`.\n"
+"    Remove `--use-replayssm` from both role scripts for this pooling scenario.\n"
+"    Keep `use_layerwise=false` and PP=DCP=1. Do not enable\n"
+"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)\n"
+"    for this deployment: its KV-transfer path does not accept `MultiConnector`."
+msgstr ""
+"保持前缀缓存、分块 prefill 和混合 KV 缓存管理器\n"
+"    启用。启用前缀缓存后，模型配置会选择\n"
+"    `mamba_cache_mode=align`，这是 `AscendStoreConnector` 所要求的。\n"
+"    对于此池化场景，从两个角色脚本中移除 `--use-replayssm`。\n"
+"    保持 `use_layerwise=false` 和 PP=DCP=1。不要为此部署启用\n"
+"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)：\n"
+"    其 KV 传输路径不接受 `MultiConnector`。"

+msgid "# Hy4-Flash(Experimental)"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"The \"PD Separation Deployment\" mentioned in this document is provided only"
+" as an example/reference design to demonstrate the basic process of "
+"deploying Prefill and Decode in separated mode. It is not recommended for "
+"use in the production environment."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"**For the production environment on the customer side, [MindIE "
+"Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md)"
+" + vLLM-Ascend is recommended.**"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"This release has been validated only on 950DT products. A2 and A3 have not "
+"yet been validated; support is planned for future releases."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"Hy4-Flash is a Mixture-of-Experts model with sliding-window attention, "
+"IndexPool sparse attention, iHC, and Engram conditional memory. The "
+"checkpoint has 42 language-model layers and an embedded five-layer DFly "
+"draft for speculative decoding."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"This document covers environment and model preparation, single-node "
+"deployment, PD disaggregation, functional verification, accuracy and "
+"performance evaluation, and performance tuning on 950DT products."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to the [Supported "
+"Models](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md) page for the "
+"support matrix and the [Feature "
+"Guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md) for feature configuration."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"The deployment scripts use native FP8 weights, BF16 computation, FP8 KV "
+"cache, expert parallelism, and Model Runner V2. The Decode service enables "
+"five-token DFly speculative decoding. All serving examples enable "
+"asynchronous scheduling. The single-node and Prefill examples enable prefix "
+"caching; PD Decode disables it."
+msgstr ""
+

+"model path used by the serving and benchmark commands below."

+"`\"dp_shared_memory\":false`，如[第 5.2 节](#52-pd-disaggregation-1p1d)所示。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
