+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-11-22 06:27+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-11-22 06:27+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Hy4 (Experimental)"
+msgstr "# Hy4（实验性）"
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr "## 1 简介"
+
+msgid ""
+"PD separation is provided as a reference deployment. For customer production"
+" deployments, follow the [MindIE "
+"Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md)"
+" + vLLM Ascend deployment guidance."
+msgstr ""
+"PD 分离作为参考部署提供。对于客户生产部署，请遵循 [MindIE "
+"Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md)"
+" + vLLM Ascend 部署指南。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This release has been validated only on 950DT products. A2 and A3 have not "
+"yet been validated; support is planned for future releases."
+msgstr "本版本仅在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上完成验证。A2 和 A3 尚未验证，计划在后续版本中支持。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This guide describes Hy4 FP8 deployment with vLLM Ascend on 950DT products. "
+"It covers single-node co-located serving, two-node co-located serving, and "
+"four-node Prefill/Decode (PD) separation. Each host uses eight NPUs."
+msgstr ""
+"本指南介绍在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 vLLM Ascend 部署 Hy4 FP8。内容涵盖单节点混部推理、双节点混部推理以及四节点 "
+"Prefill/Decode（PD）分离。每台主机使用 8 个 NPU。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The serving examples use compressed-tensors FP8 weights, expert parallelism,"
+" prefix caching, and MTP speculative decoding. The four-node PD "
+"configuration has been run successfully on 950DT products and used for "
+"measurement. It remains an experimental reference deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"推理示例使用 compressed-tensors FP8 权重、专家并行、前缀缓存和 MTP 投机解码。四节点 PD 配置已在 Ascend "
+"950DT系列产品上成功运行并用于测量。它仍属于实验性参考部署。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Hy4 uses the DFly2 architecture for its speculative module, not native MTP. "
+"It reuses vLLM's MTP method name for configuration: set `\"method\": "
+"\"mtp\"` in the speculative config to enable DFly2 speculative decoding."
+msgstr ""
+"Hy4 的投机模块采用 DFly2 架构，而非原生 MTP。它复用 vLLM 的 MTP 方法名进行配置：在投机配置中设置 `\"method\": "
+"\"mtp\"` 即可启用 DFly2 投机解码。"
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr "## 2 支持的特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to the [Supported "
+"Models](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md) page for the "
+"support matrix and the [Feature "
+"Guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md) for feature configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"支持矩阵请参阅[支持的模型](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md)页面，特性配置请参阅[特性指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md)。"
+
+msgid "## 3 Prerequisites"
+msgstr "## 3 前提条件"
+
+msgid "### 3.1 Model Weight"
+msgstr "### 3.1 模型权重"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the `tencent/Hy4-FP8` checkpoint from [Hugging "
+"Face](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-FP8) or "
+"[ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-FP8). Download"
+" the complete checkpoint, including its tokenizer, model configuration, "
+"multimodal processor files, and weights required by MTP. Make it accessible "
+"at `/path/to/Hy4-FP8` inside every serving container. Use the same "
+"checkpoint revision on every host."
+msgstr ""
+"使用来自 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-FP8) 或 "
+"[ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-FP8) 的 "
+"`tencent/Hy4-FP8` 检查点。下载完整的检查点，包括其 tokenizer、模型配置、多模态处理器文件以及 MTP "
+"所需的权重。在每个推理容器内将其置于 `/path/to/Hy4-FP8` 路径下可访问。每台主机使用相同的检查点版本。"
+
+msgid "### 3.2 Verify Multi-node Communication"
+msgstr "### 3.2 验证多节点通信"
+
+msgid ""
+"For multi-node deployment, follow [multi-node interconnect "
+"preparation](../../getting_started/installation.md#installation-multi-node-"
+"interconnect). Choose mutually reachable host IPs and the corresponding "
+"local network interfaces. Ensure HCCL connectivity and access to the API, DP"
+" coordinator, and KV transfer ports."
+msgstr ""
+"对于多节点部署，请遵循[多节点互联准备](../../getting_started/installation.md#installation-"
+"multi-node-interconnect)。选择可相互访问的主机 IP 及相应的本地网络接口。确保 HCCL 连通性，并确保 API、DP "
+"协调器和 KV 传输端口可访问。"
+
+msgid "## 4 Installation"
+msgstr "## 4 安装"
+
+msgid "### 4.1 Docker Image Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.1 Docker 镜像安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the Hy4 openEuler image `quay.io/ascend/vllm-"
+"ascend:hy4-1120-a5-openeuler` on 950DT products. The deployment was "
+"validated with the following software versions:"
+msgstr ""
+"在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 Hy4 openEuler 镜像 `quay.io/ascend/vllm-"
+"ascend:hy4-1120-a5-openeuler`。该部署已使用以下软件版本完成验证："
+
+msgid ""
+"| Hardware | Ascend HDK | CANN version | torch_npu version | vLLM | vLLM-"
+"Ascend version |"
+msgstr "| 硬件 | Ascend HDK | CANN 版本 | torch_npu 版本 | vLLM | vLLM-Ascend 版本 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| 950DT products | 25.1.rc3 | CANN 9.1.0 | 2.10.0.post4 | v0.30.0 | Based on"
+" v0.30.0 |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Ascend 950DT系列产品 | 25.1.rc3 | CANN 9.1.0 | 2.10.0.post4 | v0.30.0 | 基于 "
+"v0.30.0 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use matching vLLM, vLLM Ascend, CANN, and torch-npu versions on every host."
+msgstr "每台主机使用相匹配的 vLLM、vLLM Ascend、CANN 和 torch-npu 版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow [Installation](../../getting_started/installation.md) for the "
+"container setup appropriate to the hardware. On every host:"
+msgstr "请遵循[安装](../../getting_started/installation.md)中适用于该硬件的容器设置。在每台主机上："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Expose NPU devices 0–7 and the required management devices.\n"
+"- Mount the Ascend driver, firmware, and communication configuration required by the hardware.\n"
+"- Use host networking and sufficient shared memory.\n"
+"- Mount the weights at /path/to/Hy4-FP8.\n"
+"- Make the matching repositories accessible at /path/to/vllm-ascend and /path/to/vllm. PD scripts use both through PYTHONPATH."
+msgstr ""
+"- 暴露 NPU 设备 0–7 以及所需的管理设备。\n"
+"- 挂载硬件所需的昇腾驱动、固件和通信配置。\n"
+"- 使用主机网络和足够的共享内存。\n"
+"- 将权重挂载到 /path/to/Hy4-FP8。\n"
+"- 使匹配的代码仓库在 /path/to/vllm-ascend 和 /path/to/vllm 路径下可访问。PD 脚本通过 PYTHONPATH 使用这两个仓库。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following container template uses the Hy4 openEuler image for 950DT "
+"products. Use the matching device and communication mounts for your "
+"environment. The host model and repository directories must already contain "
+"the complete checkpoint and matching code."
+msgstr ""
+"以下容器模板使用适用于 Ascend 950DT系列产品的 Hy4 openEuler "
+"镜像。请根据您的环境使用相匹配的设备和通信挂载。主机上的模型和代码仓库目录必须已包含完整的检查点和匹配的代码。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run the following commands inside the prepared containers. Replace paths "
+"beginning with /path/to/, all address placeholders, and interface "
+"placeholders before execution. Use the same weights and software versions on"
+" every participating host."
+msgstr ""
+"在准备好的容器内运行以下命令。执行前请替换以 /path/to/ 开头的路径、所有地址占位符和接口占位符。所有参与主机使用相同的权重和软件版本。"
+
+msgid "## 5 Online Service Deployment"
+msgstr "## 5 在线服务部署"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Single-Node Co-located Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.1 单节点混部部署"
+
+msgid "=== \"950DT products\""
+msgstr "=== \"Ascend 950DT系列产品\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Run on the single serving host. Provide sufficient host RAM for prefetch "
+"weight offloading; the RAM requirement remains to be measured."
+msgstr "在单台推理主机上运行。为主机提供足够的内存用于预取权重卸载；内存需求尚待测量。"
+
+msgid "### 5.2 Two-Node Co-located Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.2 双节点混部部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the following as start_colocated.sh on both hosts. Set NODE0_IP to the "
+"same coordinator address on both hosts. Set NODE_IP and NIC for the local "
+"host. Select the indicated FRONTEND_ARGS for each node: node 0 exposes port "
+"8000 and node 1 is headless."
+msgstr ""
+"将以下内容保存为两台主机上的 start_colocated.sh。在两台主机上将 NODE0_IP 设置为相同的协调器地址。为本地主机设置 "
+"NODE_IP 和 NIC。为每个节点选择指定的 FRONTEND_ARGS：节点 0 暴露端口 8000，节点 1 为无头模式。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start node 0 first. Once its DP coordinator has started, start node 1 in "
+"another terminal. Both processes must remain running; increasing the "
+"readiness timeout does not replace starting the peer."
+msgstr "先启动节点 0。待其 DP 协调器启动后，在另一个终端启动节点 1。两个进程都必须保持运行；增大就绪超时并不能替代启动对端。"
+
+msgid "### 5.3 Four-Node PD Separation"
+msgstr "### 5.3 四节点 PD 分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use four distinct hosts. P0/P1 form one DP2 × TP8 group, and D0/D1 form "
+"another. Only P0 and D0 expose HTTP APIs. The proxy routes requests to those"
+" group frontends."
+msgstr ""
+"使用四台不同的主机。P0/P1 组成一个 DP2 × TP8 组，D0/D1 组成另一个组。仅 P0 和 D0 暴露 HTTP "
+"API。代理将请求路由到这些组前端。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Host | DP rank | API port | DP coordinator | KV role | KV rank | KV port |"
+msgstr "| 主机 | DP rank | API 端口 | DP 协调器 | KV 角色 | KV rank | KV 端口 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The KV ranks follow the supplied scripts and identify P/D groups separately "
+"from DP ranks. The reference deployment uses five MTP speculative tokens and"
+" HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024 on all four hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"KV rank 遵循所提供的脚本，并与 DP rank 分开标识 P/D 组。参考部署在全部四台主机上使用 5 个 MTP 投机 token 和 "
+"HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024。"
+
+msgid "Save the following files in the same directory on every host."
+msgstr "将以下文件保存到每台主机的同一目录中。"
+
+msgid "**config.sh**"
+msgstr "**config.sh**"
+
+msgid "Set NIC separately on each host if interface names differ."
+msgstr "如果各主机的接口名称不同，请在每台主机上分别设置 NIC。"
+
+msgid "**start_common.sh**"
+msgstr "**start_common.sh**"
+
+msgid "**Role scripts**"
+msgstr "**角色脚本**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Create one script per host using the following template and the values in "
+"the table. NODE_IP is the local host address; MASTER_IP is P0 for P roles "
+"and D0 for D roles."
+msgstr ""
+"使用以下模板和表中的值为每台主机创建一个脚本。NODE_IP 为本地主机地址；对于 P 角色，MASTER_IP 为 P0，对于 D "
+"角色，MASTER_IP 为 D0。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Script | NODE_IP | MASTER_IP | RANK | API_PORT | DP_PORT | KV_ROLE | "
+"KV_RANK | KV_PORT |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 脚本 | NODE_IP | MASTER_IP | RANK | API_PORT | DP_PORT | KV_ROLE | KV_RANK |"
+" KV_PORT |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | start_p0.sh | P0 IP | P0 IP | 0 | 18010 | 12890 | kv_producer | 0 | "
+"23000 |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | start_p0.sh | P0 IP | P0 IP | 0 | 18010 | 12890 | kv_producer | 0 | "
+"23000 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | start_p1.sh | P1 IP | P0 IP | 1 | 18010 | 12890 | kv_producer | 0 | "
+"23000 |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | start_p1.sh | P1 IP | P0 IP | 1 | 18010 | 12890 | kv_producer | 0 | "
+"23000 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | start_d0.sh | D0 IP | D0 IP | 0 | 18020 | 12891 | kv_consumer | 1 | "
+"24000 |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | start_d0.sh | D0 IP | D0 IP | 0 | 18020 | 12891 | kv_consumer | 1 | "
+"24000 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | start_d1.sh | D1 IP | D0 IP | 1 | 18020 | 12891 | kv_consumer | 1 | "
+"24000 |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | start_d1.sh | D1 IP | D0 IP | 1 | 18020 | 12891 | kv_consumer | 1 | "
+"24000 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start P0, wait for its DP coordinator, then start P1. Start D0, wait for its"
+" DP coordinator, then start D1. Check both frontend health endpoints before "
+"starting the proxy:"
+msgstr ""
+"启动 P0，等待其 DP 协调器就绪，然后启动 P1。启动 D0，等待其 DP 协调器就绪，然后启动 D1。在启动代理之前，检查两个前端的健康检查端点："
+
+msgid "**Proxy**"
+msgstr "**代理**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run on a host that can reach P0 and D0. The proxy script must be present in "
+"the matching vLLM Ascend checkout."
+msgstr "在能够访问 P0 和 D0 的主机上运行。代理脚本必须存在于对应的 vLLM Ascend 代码检出目录中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After preparing the files, use bash start_p0.sh --dry-run (or the "
+"corresponding role script) to inspect commands without starting an engine. A"
+" dry run does not validate model loading, graph capture, communication, or "
+"KV transfer."
+msgstr ""
+"准备好文件后，使用 bash start_p0.sh --dry-"
+"run（或对应角色的脚本）在不启动引擎的情况下检查命令。试运行不会验证模型加载、图捕获、通信或 KV 传输。"
+
+msgid "## 6 Functional Verification"
+msgstr "## 6 功能验证"
+
+msgid "### 6.1 Text"
+msgstr "### 6.1 文本"
+
+msgid ""
+"For co-located deployment, use the API host. For PD deployment, use the "
+"proxy host."
+msgstr "对于混部部署，使用 API 主机。对于 PD 部署，使用代理主机。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Confirm that the response uses model Hy4 and contains a valid answer. For "
+"PD, also confirm from both groups' logs that Prefill and Decode execute and "
+"KV transfer completes. An HTTP response alone is insufficient evidence of "
+"successful PD operation."
+msgstr ""
+"确认响应使用模型 Hy4 并包含有效答案。对于 PD，还需从两组日志中确认 Prefill 和 Decode 均执行且 KV 传输完成。仅凭 HTTP "
+"响应不足以证明 PD 运行成功。"
+
+msgid "### 6.2 Single Image"
+msgstr "### 6.2 单张图片"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use a local image and send it as a base64 data URL to the same chat "
+"completions endpoint. The image is read on the curl client; it does not need"
+" to be mounted in the serving container. The example uses a PNG image. "
+"Change `IMAGE_MIME` to `image/jpeg` for a JPEG image, and replace the "
+"question with one appropriate to the image. For a HallusionBench sample, use"
+" its image and the corresponding dataset question."
+msgstr ""
+"使用本地图片，将其以 base64 data URL 的形式发送到相同的 chat completions 端点。图片在 curl "
+"客户端读取，无需挂载到服务容器中。示例使用 PNG 图片。对于 JPEG 图片，将 `IMAGE_MIME` 改为 "
+"`image/jpeg`，并将问题替换为与图片相符的问题。对于 HallusionBench 样本，使用其图片及对应的数据集问题。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The four-node PD deployment supports multimodal requests and has been tested"
+" with image inputs. Send the following request to the proxy host to verify "
+"the deployed service."
+msgstr "四节点 PD 部署支持多模态请求，并已使用图片输入进行测试。向代理主机发送以下请求以验证已部署的服务。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Check that `choices[0].message.content` answers the image question and is "
+"consistent with the image. Inspect `finish_reason` and `usage` for "
+"truncation and token consumption. This single-image request is a functional "
+"check; HallusionBench accuracy requires running the dataset with its "
+"matching evaluator."
+msgstr ""
+"检查 `choices[0].message.content` 是否回答了图片问题并与图片一致。检查 `finish_reason` 和 `usage`"
+" 以确认是否截断及 token 消耗情况。此单图请求为功能检查；HallusionBench 精度需要使用其匹配的评测器运行数据集。"
+
+msgid "## 7 Accuracy Evaluation"
+msgstr "## 7 精度评估"
+
+msgid "### 7.1 Using AISBench"
+msgstr "### 7.1 使用 AISBench"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [Using "
+"AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md) for accuracy "
+"and performance evaluation. Use the serving model name Hy4 and direct PD "
+"requests to the proxy."
+msgstr ""
+"精度和性能评估请参考[使用 "
+"AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md)。使用服务模型名 "
+"Hy4，并将 PD 请求定向到代理。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Record the checkpoint revision, software versions, topology, dataset, and "
+"sampling settings with the evaluation results."
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid "### 7.2 Text Evaluation"
+msgstr "### 7.2 文本评估"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following results use the DP2 + TP8 + EP service with FP8 weights, DFly "
+"5, with prefix caching, graph and asynchronous scheduling enabled."
+msgstr "以下结果使用 DP2 + TP8 + EP 服务，FP8 权重，DFly 5，并启用前缀缓存、图和异步调度。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Dataset | Hardware | Score | max-model-len | max-num-seqs | max_out_len | "
+"batch_size | generation_kwargs |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 数据集 | 硬件 | 得分 | max-model-len | max-num-seqs | max_out_len | batch_size | "
+"generation_kwargs |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| GPQA-Diamond | Ascend 950DT | 182/198 (91.92%) | 131072 | 256 | 131072 | "
+"256 | model default config |"
+msgstr ""
+"| GPQA-Diamond | 昇腾 950DT | 182/198 (91.92%) | 131072 | 256 | 131072 | 256 |"
+" 模型默认配置 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Hullusionbench | Ascend 950DT | 960/1129 (85.03%) | 131072 | 256 | 131072 "
+"| 256 | temperature=0.8 top_k=15 top_p=0.95 repetition_penalty=1.0 |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Hullusionbench | 昇腾 950DT | 960/1129 (85.03%) | 131072 | 256 | 131072 | "
+"256 | temperature=0.8 top_k=15 top_p=0.95 repetition_penalty=1.0 |"
+
+msgid "## 8 Performance Evaluation"
+msgstr "## 8 性能评估"
+
+msgid "### 8.1 Using vLLM Bench"
+msgstr "### 8.1 使用 vLLM Bench"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run the following from a prepared client environment with access to the "
+"complete checkpoint tokenizer. Set the server address to the API host for "
+"co-located serving or the proxy host for PD separation. This initial "
+"workload fits the single-node example's context limit; adapt the workload to"
+" the intended use case after functional verification."
+msgstr ""
+"在已准备好且可访问完整检查点分词器的客户端环境中运行以下命令。对于混部服务，将服务器地址设置为 API 主机；对于 PD "
+"分离，设置为代理主机。此初始负载符合单节点示例的上下文限制；在功能验证后，请根据预期用例调整负载。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For additional evaluation methods, refer to [AISBench performance "
+"evaluation](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md#execute-"
+"performance-evaluation). No measured throughput, latency, or MTP acceptance "
+"results are provided in this guide."
+msgstr ""
+"其他评估方法请参考 [AISBench "
+"性能评估](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md#execute-"
+"performance-evaluation)。本指南不提供实测吞吐量、时延或 MTP 接受率结果。"
+
+msgid "## 9 Performance Tuning"
+msgstr "## 9 性能调优"
+
+msgid "### 9.1 Reference Configurations"
+msgstr "### 9.1 参考配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the configuration table in [Supported Features](#2-supported-features) "
+"as the starting point for each topology. Single-node serving uses weight "
+"offloading and a small KV cache to reduce device memory requirements. Two-"
+"node serving distributes experts across both hosts without weight "
+"offloading. The PD example uses separate two-host groups for Prefill and "
+"Decode."
+msgstr ""
+"以[支持特性](#2-supported-features)中的配置表作为每种拓扑的起点。单节点服务使用权重卸载和较小的 KV "
+"缓存以降低设备内存需求。双节点服务将专家分布到两台主机上，不使用权重卸载。PD 示例为 Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自独立的两主机组。"
+
+msgid "### 9.2 Tuning Guidelines"
+msgstr "### 9.2 调优指南"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Tune concurrency and token budgets against the actual available memory. A configured maximum model length does not establish that every request at that length can run at the configured maximum concurrency.\n"
+"- Account for host RAM and transfer bandwidth when using single-node prefetch weight offloading.\n"
+"- Compare MTP acceptance and latency with the same workload before changing the speculative token count. Keep the topology-specific scheduling settings until changes have been validated.\n"
+"- Keep the Prefill and Decode topology declarations consistent in both groups' KV connector configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"- 根据实际可用内存调整并发数和 token 预算。配置了最大模型长度并不意味着该长度下的每个请求都能以配置的最大并发数运行。\n"
+"- 使用单节点预取权重卸载时，需考虑主机内存和传输带宽。\n"
+"- 在更改投机 token 数量之前，使用相同负载比较 MTP 接受率和时延。在变更得到验证之前，保持特定拓扑的调度设置不变。\n"
+"- 在两组 KV 连接器配置中保持 Prefill 和 Decode 拓扑声明一致。"
+
+msgid "## 10 FAQ"
+msgstr "## 10 常见问题"
+
+msgid "### 10.1 Multi-node Startup Waits for a Peer"
+msgstr "### 10.1 多节点启动时等待对端"
+
+msgid ""
+"Confirm that every DP rank has started, that the group coordinator address "
+"is consistent, and that each local IP belongs to the selected network "
+"interface. Check inter-node connectivity and coordinator ports. Increasing "
+"the engine readiness timeout does not resolve a missing or unreachable peer."
+msgstr ""
+"确认每个 DP rank 均已启动、组协调器地址一致，且每个本地 IP "
+"属于所选网络接口。检查节点间连通性和协调器端口。增大引擎就绪超时并不能解决对端缺失或不可达的问题。"
+
+msgid "### 10.2 Single-Node Deployment Runs Out of Memory"
+msgstr "### 10.2 单节点部署内存不足"
+
+msgid ""
+"Check both device memory and host RAM. The example uses prefetch weight "
+"offloading and an explicit KV cache allocation. Confirm that the weight-"
+"offload configuration is active before increasing sequence length, "
+"concurrency, or KV cache allocation."
+msgstr ""
+"同时检查设备内存和主机 RAM。该示例使用了预取权重卸载和显式的 KV cache 分配。在增加序列长度、并发数或 KV cache "
+"分配之前，请确认权重卸载配置已生效。"
+
+msgid "### 10.3 PD Requests Do Not Complete"
+msgstr "### 10.3 PD 请求无法完成"
+
+msgid ""
+"Check P0 and D0 health independently, then verify the proxy's frontend "
+"addresses and ports. Check both groups' logs for KV connector initialization"
+" and transfer errors. Confirm matching Mooncake versions and the DP/TP "
+"topology in both connector configurations."
+msgstr ""
+"分别检查 P0 和 D0 的健康状态，然后验证代理的前端地址和端口。检查两组日志中是否有 KV 连接器初始化和传输错误。确认两个连接器配置中的 "
+"Mooncake 版本一致，且 DP/TP 拓扑匹配。"

+
+msgid "# NPU Device Selection"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"Use `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to restrict the NPUs visible to a process, and\n"
+"`--device-ids` to select devices for a vLLM multiprocessing executor. Setting\n"
+"`--tensor-parallel-size` controls the number of workers; it does not select\n"
+"particular NPUs."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 限制进程可见的 NPU，并使用\n"
+"`--device-ids` 为 vLLM 多进程执行器选择设备。设置\n"
+"`--tensor-parallel-size` 控制 worker 的数量；它并不会选择\n"
+"特定的 NPU。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The examples below use integer device IDs, a single node, and the `mp` executor.\n"
+"Use matching vLLM and vLLM Ascend versions from the\n"
+"[installation guide](../../getting_started/installation.md). Ray has a different selection\n"
+"mechanism; see [Ray](#ray) below."
+msgstr ""
+"以下示例使用整数设备 ID、单节点和 `mp` 执行器。\n"
+"请使用[安装指南](../../getting_started/installation.md)中匹配的 vLLM 和 vLLM Ascend 版本。\n"
+"Ray 具有不同的选择机制；请参阅下方的 [Ray](#ray)。"
+
+msgid "## How the two settings interact"
+msgstr "## 两个设置如何相互作用"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Set `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` **before** starting vLLM. It remains supported;\n"
+"  explicit device selection does not require removing this environment variable.\n"
+"- If the variable is unset, integer `--device-ids` values select NPU IDs directly\n"
+"  in the current environment.\n"
+"- If the variable is set, integer `--device-ids` values are **zero-based indices\n"
+"  into that visible list**, in the specified order. They are not a second list\n"
+"  of host device IDs.\n"
+"- If `--device-ids` is omitted, vLLM allocates workers from the available visible\n"
+"  devices according to the parallel configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在启动 vLLM **之前**设置 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES`。该变量仍然受支持；\n"
+"  显式设备选择不需要移除该环境变量。\n"
+"- 如果该变量未设置，整数 `--device-ids` 值直接在当前环境中选择 NPU ID。\n"
+"- 如果该变量已设置，整数 `--device-ids` 值是**该可见列表中的从零开始的索引**，\n"
+"  按指定顺序排列。它们不是第二份主机设备 ID 列表。\n"
+"- 如果省略 `--device-ids`，vLLM 会根据并行配置从可用的可见设备中\n"
+"  分配 worker。"
+
+msgid "For TP2 on a machine exposing IDs `0` through `7`:"
+msgstr "在暴露 ID `0` 到 `7` 的机器上使用 TP2："
+
+msgid ""
+"| `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` | `--device-ids` | Selected NPU IDs | Worker "
+"runtime devices |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` | `--device-ids` | 选中的 NPU ID | Worker 运行时设备 |"
+
+msgid "| Unset | Omitted | `0,1` | `npu:0`, `npu:1` |"
+msgstr "| 未设置 | 省略 | `0,1` | `npu:0`, `npu:1` |"
+
+msgid "| Unset | `1,3` | `1,3` | `npu:1`, `npu:3` |"
+msgstr "| 未设置 | `1,3` | `1,3` | `npu:1`, `npu:3` |"
+
+msgid "| `4,5,6,7` | Omitted | `4,5` | `npu:0`, `npu:1` |"
+msgstr "| `4,5,6,7` | 省略 | `4,5` | `npu:0`, `npu:1` |"
+
+msgid "| `4,5,6,7` | `1,3` | `5,7` | `npu:1`, `npu:3` |"
+msgstr "| `4,5,6,7` | `1,3` | `5,7` | `npu:1`, `npu:3` |"
+
+msgid "| `4,5,6,7` | `3,1` | `7,5` | `npu:3`, `npu:1` |"
+msgstr "| `4,5,6,7` | `3,1` | `7,5` | `npu:3`, `npu:1` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"For example, `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 --device-ids 3,1` selects entries\n"
+"`7,5`, not devices `3,1`. Conversely, `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3` combined\n"
+"with `--device-ids 1,3` is invalid: index `3` is outside a two-device list."
+msgstr ""
+"例如，`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 --device-ids 3,1` 选择的是条目\n"
+"`7,5`，而不是设备 `3,1`。相反，`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3` 与\n"
+"`--device-ids 1,3` 组合是无效的：索引 `3` 超出了包含两个设备的列表范围。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The runtime device number is relative to the process's visibility, so `npu:0`\n"
+"does not necessarily mean host device `0`. Container device mounts can further\n"
+"restrict or remap devices; use IDs available inside the container. Neither\n"
+"setting exposes devices that the container has not been granted."
+msgstr ""
+"运行时设备编号是相对于进程可见性而言的，因此 `npu:0`\n"
+"不一定表示主机设备 `0`。容器设备挂载可能会进一步\n"
+"限制或重映射设备；请使用容器内可用的 ID。这两个设置\n"
+"都不会暴露容器未被授予的设备。"
+
+msgid "## Tensor parallelism"
+msgstr "## 张量并行"
+
+msgid "Select two non-contiguous devices without a visibility override:"
+msgstr "在不覆盖可见性的情况下选择两个非连续设备："
+
+msgid "Alternatively, restrict the visible set and omit `--device-ids`:"
+msgstr "或者，限制可见集合并省略 `--device-ids`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Run these as alternatives, not simultaneously on the same devices. Adjust the\n"
+"model and memory settings for your hardware."
+msgstr ""
+"请将这些作为备选方案运行，不要在同一设备上同时运行。请根据你的硬件\n"
+"调整模型和内存设置。"
+
+msgid "## Data parallelism"
+msgstr "## 数据并行"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a single launch with two local DP replicas, each using TP2, provide the full\n"
+"four-device list. vLLM splits it between the replicas; do not pass only one\n"
+"replica's two-device slice to this launch."
+msgstr ""
+"对于单次启动两个本地 DP 副本、每个副本使用 TP2 的情况，请提供完整的\n"
+"四设备列表。vLLM 会在副本之间进行拆分；不要只将一个副本的\n"
+"两设备切片传递给此次启动。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replica 0 uses `1,3`; replica 1 uses `5,7`. For this single-node DP/TP layout,\n"
+"allocate `DP × TP` distinct devices. An equivalent visibility-only launch uses\n"
+"`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3,5,7` and omits `--device-ids`."
+msgstr ""
+"副本 0 使用 `1,3`；副本 1 使用 `5,7`。对于这种单节点 DP/TP 布局，\n"
+"请分配 `DP × TP` 个不同的设备。等效的仅可见性启动方式使用\n"
+"`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3,5,7` 并省略 `--device-ids`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Multi-node or separately launched DP ranks have different launch arguments and\n"
+"local device allocations. Follow the model's deployment tutorial rather than\n"
+"copying this single-launch layout unchanged."
+msgstr ""
+"多节点或单独启动的 DP rank 具有不同的启动参数和\n"
+"本地设备分配。请遵循模型的部署教程，而不是\n"
+"原样复制此单次启动布局。"
+
+msgid "## Prefill-decode disaggregation"
+msgstr "## Prefill-Decode 分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"P and D are separate vLLM instances. On the same host, assign them disjoint\n"
+"device sets and different service/connector ports. For example, with TP2 on\n"
+"each side:"
+msgstr ""
+"P 和 D 是独立的 vLLM 实例。在同一主机上，请为它们分配不相交的\n"
+"设备集合以及不同的服务/连接器端口。例如，每一侧都使用 TP2："
+
+msgid ""
+"| Instance | Visibility-only selection | Alternative with visibility unset |"
+msgstr "| 实例 | 仅可见性选择 | 可见性未设置时的备选方案 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Prefill | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2`, omit `--device-ids` | "
+"`--device-ids 0,2` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Prefill | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2`，省略 `--device-ids` | `--device-"
+"ids 0,2` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Decode | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,6`, omit `--device-ids` | `--device-"
+"ids 4,6` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Decode | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,6`，省略 `--device-ids` | `--device-ids"
+" 4,6` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"These are device assignments, not complete PD launch commands. Keep the model,\n"
+"KV connector, proxy, and communication configuration from the\n"
+"[single-node PD tutorial](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_single_node.md)\n"
+"or the [multi-node PD tutorial](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md).\n"
+"On different hosts, the same numeric device IDs can refer to different NPUs."
+msgstr ""
+"这些是设备分配，而不是完整的 PD 启动命令。请保留来自\n"
+"[单节点 PD 教程](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_single_node.md)\n"
+"或[多节点 PD 教程](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md)的模型、\n"
+"KV 连接器、代理和通信配置。\n"
+"在不同主机上，相同的数字设备 ID 可能指代不同的 NPU。"
+
+msgid "## Ray"
+msgstr "## Ray"
+
+msgid ""
+"`--device-ids` has no effect with `--distributed-executor-backend ray`; vLLM\n"
+"prints a warning. Ray placement groups determine which resources workers use.\n"
+"Set each node's `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` before starting its Ray processes,\n"
+"and follow the [Ray tutorial](../../tutorials/features/ray.md) for cluster and\n"
+"environment configuration. Changing the variable in a later client shell does\n"
+"not reconfigure an already running Ray cluster."
+msgstr ""
+"`--device-ids` 在 `--distributed-executor-backend ray` 下不起作用；vLLM\n"
+"会打印警告。Ray 放置组决定 worker 使用哪些资源。\n"
+"请在启动每个节点的 Ray 进程之前设置该节点的 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES`，\n"
+"并遵循 [Ray 教程](../../tutorials/features/ray.md)进行集群和\n"
+"环境配置。在后续客户端 shell 中更改变量\n"
+"不会重新配置已在运行的 Ray 集群。"
+
+msgid "## Check the allocation"
+msgstr "## 检查分配情况"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use distinct integer indices within the visible-list bounds. Duplicate IDs\n"
+"  and out-of-range indices are rejected.\n"
+"- Supply enough devices for the local parallel layout. For example, TP2 with\n"
+"  `--device-ids 1` cannot start two workers.\n"
+"- Check worker startup logs and the `npu-smi info` process table in the relevant\n"
+"  host/container environment. Account for visibility remapping when comparing\n"
+"  runtime device numbers with the selected NPUs.\n"
+"- A successful HTTP response alone does not establish correct device placement.\n"
+"  For DP and PD, verify every replica or instance, not just the API server."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用可见列表范围内的不同整数索引。重复的 ID\n"
+"  和超出范围的索引会被拒绝。\n"
+"- 为本地并行布局提供足够的设备。例如，TP2 搭配\n"
+"  `--device-ids 1` 无法启动两个 worker。\n"
+"- 在相关的主机/容器环境中检查 worker 启动日志和 `npu-smi info` 进程表。\n"
+"  在将运行时设备编号与选中的 NPU 进行比较时，请考虑可见性重映射。\n"
+"- 仅凭成功的 HTTP 响应并不能确定设备放置正确。\n"
+"  对于 DP 和 PD，请验证每个副本或实例，而不仅仅是 API 服务器。"

+"- **embedding / LM head (fixed-capacity exchanges)**: the exchange always runs at a fixed, deployment-wide capacity regardless of the real per-step token count, and the padding tail is trimmed afterwards. Because the collective shapes never depend on the step, these knobs work in eager and graph mode, in both prefill and decode.\n"
+"- **o_proj / MLP (per-step exchanges that require decode-shaped steps)**: the exchange is sized by the actual step. These knobs are supported only in graph-dispatched P/D decode deployments, where steps stay decode-shaped and aligned across the DP group — see the [preconditions for o_proj / MLP TP](#preconditions-for-o_proj--mlp-tp) and the runtime guard against eagerly dispatched steps.\n"
+"- **QKV IProj (per-step exchanges with padding)** shards the GLM-5.3-Flash KDA Q/K/V and beta projection weights by head. After projection, `all_to_all` restores the full set of heads on each request's DP owner and overlaps with the local forget and gate up-projections. Each owner runs the recurrent core and keeps its convolution and recurrent state. Configure output projection TP independently with `oproj_tensor_parallel_size`."
+msgstr ""
+"- **embedding / LM head（固定容量交换）**：交换始终以部署范围内固定的容量运行，与每一步真实的 token 数量无关，随后再裁剪填充尾部。对于 embedding，该算子会在 `all_gather` 之前将 token ID 填充到 `max(potential_max_tokens, max_num_batched_tokens)`，查找其词表分片，然后通过 `reduce_scatter` 将 embedding 归还给原始所有者——包括 prefill 规模的步骤。对于 LM head，runner 会在 `all_gather → 词表分片 GEMM → all_to_all` 之前将采样得到的隐藏状态行填充到 `max_num_reqs * decode_query_len`，空闲的 DP rank 则通过相同容量下的虚拟 `compute_logits` 加入。由于集合通信的形状从不依赖于具体步骤，这些配置项在 eager 模式和图模式下、在 prefill 和 decode 中均可工作。\n"
+"- **o_proj / MLP（需要 decode 形状步骤的逐步交换）**：交换的大小由实际步骤决定。MLP 运行普通的 `all_gather`（gate_up）/ `reduce_scatter`（down），其形状跟随真实 token 数量，因此组内每个 rank 在每一步都必须前向相同数量的 token。o_proj 会填充到静态容量——`potential_max_tokens`，即部署范围内的步骤上限（最大的 cudagraph 捕获大小，且至少为最大的 decode 形状步骤）——超出该容量时会显式失败。这些配置项仅在由图调度的 P/D decode 部署中受支持，此类部署中步骤保持 decode 形状并在 DP 组内对齐——参见 [o_proj / MLP TP 的前提条件](#preconditions-for-o_proj--mlp-tp) 以及针对 eager 调度步骤的运行时保护。\n"
+"- **QKV IProj（带填充的逐步交换）** 按 head 对 GLM-5.3-Flash KDA Q/K/V 和 beta 投影权重进行分片。每个 rank 在 `all_gather` 之前根据 DP token 数量将其隐藏状态填充到共享容量，包括空闲 rank。投影之后，`all_to_all` 在每个请求的 DP 所有者上恢复完整的 head 集合，并与本地的 forget 和 gate 上投影重叠。每个所有者运行循环核心并保留其卷积和循环状态。使用 `oproj_tensor_parallel_size` 独立配置输出投影 TP。"
+

@@ -660,11 +600,82 @@ msgstr ""
 
 msgid ""
 "- **ACLGraph** (capture/replay via `torch.npu.NPUGraph`) is the runtime graph execution mechanism used by the default graph path on Ascend.\n"
-"- **Npugraph_ex** is a compile-time FX graph optimization layer, enabled by default in FULL/FULL_DECODE_ONLY modes. It optimizes the graph before ACLGraph captures it.\n"
+"- **Npugraph_ex** is a compile-time FX graph optimization layer, enabled by default in every graph mode (`NONE` disables it). It optimizes the graph before ACLGraph captures it.\n"
 "- **XliteGraph** is an optional graph path for selected model families and environments.\n"
 "- In context parallel scenarios, `cudagraph_mode=\"FULL\"` is not sufficiently supported yet."
 msgstr ""
 "- **ACLGraph**（通过 `torch.npu.NPUGraph` 进行捕获/重放）是昇腾上默认图路径所使用的运行时图执行机制。\n"
-"- **Npugraph_ex** 是编译期的 FX 图优化层，在 FULL/FULL_DECODE_ONLY 模式下默认启用。它在 ACLGraph 捕获图之前对图进行优化。\n"
+"- **Npugraph_ex** 是编译期 FX 图优化层，在所有图模式下默认启用（`NONE` 会将其禁用）。它在 ACLGraph 捕获图之前对图进行优化。\n"
 "- **XliteGraph** 是针对特定模型系列和环境可选使用的图路径。\n"
 "- 在上下文并行场景下，`cudagraph_mode=\"FULL\"` 尚未得到充分支持。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **FULL_AND_PIECEWISE**: Default mode, same as the upstream vLLM strategy. The compile-time path follows PIECEWISE compilation, while the runtime may still use full-graph behavior for uniform decode batches.\n"
+"- **FULL / FULL_DECODE_ONLY**: Npugraph_ex optimizes the FX graph via npugraph_ex (`force_eager=True`, compile-time only, no capture). The optimized callable is then captured and replayed by ACLGraph at runtime.\n"
+"- **PIECEWISE**: Npugraph_ex compiles each piece (`force_eager=True`, compile-time only, no capture) and applies the FX fusion passes per piece. ACLGraph captures and replays each piece at runtime.\n"
+"- **NONE**: No compilation or graph capture. The model runs in eager mode."
+msgstr ""
+"- **FULL_AND_PIECEWISE**：默认模式，与上游 vLLM 策略相同。编译期路径遵循 PIECEWISE 编译，而运行时对于均匀的 decode 批次仍可能使用全图行为。\n"
+"- **FULL / FULL_DECODE_ONLY**：Npugraph_ex 通过 npugraph_ex 优化 FX 图（`force_eager=True`，仅编译期，不捕获）。随后优化后的可调用对象在运行时由 ACLGraph 捕获并重放。\n"
+"- **PIECEWISE**：Npugraph_ex 编译每个分片（`force_eager=True`，仅编译期，不捕获），并对每个分片应用 FX 融合 pass。ACLGraph 在运行时捕获并重放每个分片。\n"
+"- **NONE**：不进行编译或图捕获。模型以 eager 模式运行。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| FULL_AND_PIECEWISE | Piecewise compilation path (per-piece Npugraph_ex) | "
+"Mixed: PIECEWISE for mixed batches, FULL-capable for uniform decode batches "
+"| Enabled |"
+msgstr ""
+"| FULL_AND_PIECEWISE | 分片编译路径（逐分片 Npugraph_ex） | 混合：混合批次使用 PIECEWISE，均匀 "
+"decode 批次可使用 FULL | 已启用 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PIECEWISE | Per-piece Npugraph_ex + fusion passes | ACLGraph "
+"capture/replay per piece | Enabled |"
+msgstr "| PIECEWISE | 逐分片 Npugraph_ex + 融合 pass | 逐分片 ACLGraph 捕获/重放 | 已启用 |"
+
+msgid "### Explicit cudagraph_mode configuration"
+msgstr "### 显式配置 cudagraph_mode"
+
+msgid ""
+"As introduced in the [Npugraph_ex RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-"
+"ascend/issues/4715), Npugraph_ex is a compile-time FX graph optimization "
+"layer that works together with ACLGraph. It optimizes the model's FX graph "
+"before ACLGraph captures it at runtime. Its performance benefits mainly come"
+" from fusing multiple operators into single kernels (e.g., add + rms_norm → "
+"npu_add_rms_norm) to reduce kernel launch overhead."
+msgstr ""
+"如 [Npugraph_ex RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/4715)"
+" 中所介绍，Npugraph_ex 是一个编译期 FX 图优化层，与 ACLGraph 协同工作。它在 ACLGraph 于运行时捕获图之前对模型的 "
+"FX 图进行优化。其性能收益主要来自将多个算子融合为单个 kernel（例如 add + rms_norm → "
+"npu_add_rms_norm），以减少 kernel 启动开销。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Npugraph_ex is **enabled by default** on supported hardware in every graph "
+"mode. Under `FULL`/`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` it optimizes the whole FX graph; under"
+" `PIECEWISE`/`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` it compiles each piece with "
+"`force_eager=True`. It is automatically disabled in `NONE` mode."
+msgstr ""
+"在支持的硬件上，Npugraph_ex 在所有图模式下均**默认启用**。在 `FULL`/`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 下，它优化整个 FX "
+"图；在 `PIECEWISE`/`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` 下，它以 `force_eager=True` 编译每个分片。在 `NONE`"
+" 模式下它会自动禁用。"
+
+msgid "For example, with a full graph mode:"
+msgstr "例如，使用全图模式："
+
+msgid ""
+"Under `PIECEWISE` and `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`, static kernels are compiled for "
+"the cudagraph capture sizes (pieces are captured and replayed exactly at "
+"those shapes); on newer vllm the prefill token grid and the decode request "
+"grid are resolved separately and both are covered. Under other modes, the "
+"compile set covers decode batch sizes."
+msgstr ""
+"在 `PIECEWISE` 和 `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` 下，会针对 cudagraph 捕获尺寸编译静态 "
+"kernel（分片会严格按照这些形状进行捕获和重放）；在较新的 vllm 中，prefill token 网格和 decode "
+"请求网格会分别解析，两者均被覆盖。在其他模式下，编译集合覆盖 decode 批次大小。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For more details about Npugraph_ex, see the [Npugraph_ex "
+"guide](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/2600/modthirdparty/torchairuseguide/docs/zh/overview.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"有关 Npugraph_ex 的更多详细信息，请参阅 [Npugraph_ex "
+"指南](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/2600/modthirdparty/torchairuseguide/docs/zh/overview.md)。"

+msgid ""
+"In Embedded Real Client mode, Mooncake is embedded in vLLM. When vLLM "

+"with no separate `mooncake_client` process required."
+msgstr ""
+"在嵌入式真实客户端模式下，Mooncake 嵌入在 vLLM 中。vLLM "
+"启动时，`AscendStoreConnector`/`MooncakeBackend` 会使用 `mooncake.json` 中的配置自动调用 "
+"`MooncakeDistributedStore.setup()`，无需单独的 `mooncake_client` 进程。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Memcache backend requires both `memcache-hybrid >= 1.3.0` and "
+"`memfabric-hybrid >= 1.3.0`."
+msgstr ""
+"Memcache 后端需要同时满足 `memcache-hybrid >= 1.3.0` 和 `memfabric-hybrid >= 1.3.0`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This deployment mode runs Memcache and vLLM in different processes (distinct"
+" from vLLM PD disaggregation). In the default co-located mode, vLLM loads "
+"the model weights before the KV connector initializes Memcache, so Memcache "
+"may not be able to reserve sufficient memory from the remaining available "
+"space. Starting a standalone Memcache process before vLLM allows Memcache to"
+" reserve a larger memory pool."
+msgstr ""
+"此部署模式将 Memcache 和 vLLM 运行在不同的进程中（与 vLLM PD 分离不同）。在默认的同机部署模式下，vLLM 会在 KV "
+"连接器初始化 Memcache 之前加载模型权重，因此 Memcache 可能无法从剩余可用空间中预留足够的内存。在 vLLM 之前启动独立的 "
+"Memcache 进程，可以让 Memcache 预留更大的内存池。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare two LocalService configuration files with the same connection and "
+"protocol settings: the configuration used by the vLLM process does not "
+"contribute DRAM (`dram.size = 0GB`), and the configuration used by the "
+"standalone Memcache process specifies the amount of DRAM to contribute. Set "
+"`ock.mmc.local_service.max.dram.size` to accommodate the maximum `dram.size`"
+" used by the LocalService processes."
+msgstr ""
+"准备两个具有相同连接和协议设置的 LocalService 配置文件：vLLM 进程使用的配置不贡献 DRAM（`dram.size = "
+"0GB`），独立 Memcache 进程使用的配置则指定要贡献的 DRAM 大小。将 "
+"`ock.mmc.local_service.max.dram.size` 设置为能够容纳各 LocalService 进程所使用的最大 "
+"`dram.size`。"

+msgid ""
+"### Issue 8: Lazy Init for KV Pool with Fabric Memory and Specific Models"
+msgstr "### 问题 8：启用 Fabric 内存且使用特定模型时 KV Pool 的延迟初始化"
+
+msgid ""
+"On HDK versions earlier than 26.1, when fabric memory is enabled "
+"(`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1`) and running one of the affected model "
+"families below, the vLLM service hangs during startup with the KV Pool "
+"enabled. Lazy store initialization defers the store setup so the service "
+"starts normally."
+msgstr ""
+"在低于 26.1 的 HDK 版本上，当启用 fabric "
+"内存（`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1`）并运行以下受影响的模型系列之一时，启用 KV Pool 的 vLLM "
+"服务会在启动过程中挂起。延迟存储初始化会推迟存储的建立，从而使服务能够正常启动。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When lazy init is enabled, the store is not created during backend "
+"construction. Instead, it is set up on the first `put()` call and guarded by"
+" a lock, so later `put()` calls reuse the same store. Before the first "
+"`put()`, `exists()` treats keys as missing so the first store request can "
+"reach `put()`; pool lookups that happen before initialization therefore "
+"report a miss and the affected requests fall back to recompute once — a safe"
+" degradation, not an error."
+msgstr ""
+"启用延迟初始化后，存储不会在后端构建期间创建，而是在首次调用 `put()` 时建立，并由锁保护，因此后续的 `put()` "
+"调用会复用同一个存储。在首次 `put()` 之前，`exists()` 会将键视为不存在，以便第一个存储请求能够到达 "
+"`put()`；因此在初始化之前发生的池查找会报告未命中，受影响的请求会回退到重新计算一次——这是一种安全的降级，而非错误。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Lazy initialization is requested automatically — no configuration is needed "
+"— for the following model families when the Mooncake/Memcache backend runs "
+"under fabric memory:"
+msgstr "当 Mooncake/Memcache 后端在 fabric 内存下运行时，以下模型系列会自动请求延迟初始化——无需任何配置："
+
+msgid "| Model family | When lazy init is requested |"
+msgstr "| 模型系列 | 请求延迟初始化的条件 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| DeepSeek V4 compressed models (checkpoint carries `compress_ratios`) | "
+"`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1` (fabric memory enabled) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| DeepSeek V4 压缩模型（checkpoint 携带 `compress_ratios`） | "
+"`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1`（启用 fabric 内存） |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| GLM-5.x sparse-indexer (SFA) models with an int8 or fp8 KV cache | "
+"`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1` + packed C8 KV cache path active. On "
+"v0.26-based releases this path is enabled by `c8_enable_reshape_optim`; on "
+"newer releases it is the native default for int8/fp8 KV cache dtype and the "
+"switch no longer exists. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 使用 int8 或 fp8 KV 缓存的 GLM-5.x 稀疏索引器（SFA）模型 | "
+"`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1` + 打包 C8 KV 缓存路径已激活。在基于 v0.26 的版本中，该路径由 "
+"`c8_enable_reshape_optim` 启用；在更新的版本中，它是 int8/fp8 KV 缓存数据类型的原生默认行为，该开关已不存在。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"All other models — dense models, and sparse-indexer models with other KV "
+"cache dtypes — keep the previous eager store setup unchanged."
+msgstr "所有其他模型——稠密模型，以及使用其他 KV 缓存数据类型的稀疏索引器模型——保持之前的即时存储建立方式不变。"

-msgid ""
-"With Engram CPU offload enabled, RFork transfers NPU weights while offloaded DeepSeek V4.1 Engram tables are loaded\n"
-"from the local checkpoint. Every receiver therefore needs the matching indexed\n"
-"safetensors checkpoint, including the Engram weights and scales, even when a seed\n"
-"is available. RFork reuses the Engram shard reader and supports `dp_shared_memory=true`\n"
-"through its existing shared-writer synchronization. Host tables and process-local\n"
-"UVA pointers are not transferred."
-msgstr ""
-"启用 Engram CPU 卸载时，RFork 在从本地检查点加载已卸载的 DeepSeek V4.1 Engram 表时传输 NPU "
-"权重。因此，每个接收端都需要匹配的已建立索引的 safetensors 检查点，即使已有 seed，也必须包含 Engram 权重和 "
-"scale。RFork 复用 Engram 分片读取器，并通过现有的共享写入同步机制支持 "
-"`dp_shared_memory=true`。主机表和进程本地 UVA 指针不会被传输。"
-

-"The host-table rules below apply only with Engram CPU offload. The host table must finish loading before destination registration or shared-weight\n"
-"reuse. RFork records completion for the supported DeepSeek table implementation\n"
-"and checks tensor identity, storage address, and checkpoint binding before exempting\n"
-"its host tensors from the non-NPU state check. Other registered parameters and\n"
-"buffers that remain on CPU are still rejected. After the default loader successfully returns, RFork records the same\n"
-"state so the locally loaded instance can publish its NPU weights as a seed.\n"
-"The model implementation and its default loading path require no RFork hooks."
-msgstr ""
-"以下主机表规则仅适用于 Engram CPU 卸载。目标端注册或复用共享权重之前，主机表必须完成加载。对于受支持的 DeepSeek 表实现，RFork 会记录完成\n"
-"状态，并在将其主机张量从非 NPU 状态检查中豁免前，校验张量身份、存储地址和检查点绑定关系。仍保留在\n"
-"CPU 上的其他已注册参数和缓冲区仍会被拒绝。默认加载器成功返回后，RFork 会记录相同状态，使本地加载\n"

-msgid ""
-"When a draft model is loaded after its target model, RFork checks whether every transferable draft tensor already falls\n"
-"inside a weight block registered by the target. If all draft weights are shared, no draft weight is independent, and no\n"
-"non-NPU state remains, RFork skips destination registration, seed acquisition, and the TransferEngine copy. It also\n"
-"skips post-load processing, because reprocessing can mutate target-owned storage, then finalizes the model and logs\n"
-"`source=shared_target`. This path never contacts the planner and does not publish the draft as a separate seed."
-msgstr ""
-"当 draft 模型在其 target 模型之后加载时，RFork 会检查每个可传输的 draft 张量是否都已落在 target "
-"注册的权重块内。如果所有 draft 权重都共享、没有独立的 draft 权重，且不存在非 NPU 状态，RFork 会跳过目标端注册、seed 获取和"
-" TransferEngine 复制。它还会跳过加载后处理，因为重新处理可能改写 target 持有的存储；随后完成模型 finalize 并记录 "
-"`source=shared_target`。此路径不会联系规划器，也不会将 draft 作为独立 seed 发布。"
-
-msgid ""

-"aborts startup rather than mixing shared and transferred draft weights."

-msgid ""
-"For MTP drafts using `AscendDeepSeekMTP` and DeepSeek V4/V4.1 DSpark drafts, RFork prepares checkpoint-dependent\n"
-"state before registering tensors: head ownership and module aliases for `AscendDeepSeekMTP`, and embedding and head\n"
-"ownership for DSpark. It reads the names in the selected safetensors headers using the default loader's source,\n"
-"revision, and file-selection rules. Uncached remote checkpoints may be downloaded during this preparation. If the\n"
-"metadata cannot be read, including checkpoints selected in PT/bin format, RFork uses the default loader and does not\n"
-"publish that model as a seed. This adaptation stays within the RFork loader. For `AscendDeepSeekMTP`, it reuses the\n"
-"model's head-ownership helper. For DSpark, it reuses the model's checkpoint-name mapping together with the\n"
-"embedding/head naming rule from its `load_weights`. It currently covers only these drafts. Other draft\n"
-"implementations, such as `Glm5NextMTP` and other DSpark drafts, also derive head ownership from checkpoint weights,\n"
-"and RFork does not run their normal `load_weights` before registration; qualify `source=transfer` and output accuracy\n"
-"on the target model and hardware before relying on draft weight reuse."
-msgstr ""
-"对于采用 `AscendDeepSeekMTP` 实现的 MTP draft 和 DeepSeek V4/V4.1 DSpark draft，RFork"
-" 会在注册张量前准备依赖检查点的状态：`AscendDeepSeekMTP` 准备 head 所有权和模块别名，DSpark 准备 embedding "
-"和 head 所有权。它会按照默认加载器的 source、revision 和文件选择规则，读取所选 safetensors "
-"头部中的名称。准备过程中可能下载未缓存的远程检查点。如果无法读取元数据（包括以 PT/bin 格式选择的检查点），RFork "
-"会使用默认加载器，并不会将该模型发布为 seed。此适配保留在 RFork 加载器内：对 `AscendDeepSeekMTP`，复用模型的 head "
-"所有权辅助函数；对 DSpark，复用模型的检查点名称映射，以及其 `load_weights` 中 embedding/head "
-"的命名规则。目前仅覆盖这些 draft。其他 draft 实现（例如 `Glm5NextMTP` 和其他 DSpark draft）同样从检查点权重推导"
-" head 所有权，而 RFork 在注册前不会执行它们正常的 `load_weights`；在依赖 draft 权重复用前，请在目标模型和硬件上验证 "

-msgid ""
-"The YuanRong TransferEngine RPC port is not a configuration field: RFork initializes the engine with port `0`, and the\n"
-"engine binds and holds an OS-assigned port that RFork reads back via `get_rpc_port()` and publishes as the transfer\n"
-"session endpoint. The endpoint host is chosen independently by vLLM's `get_ip()`, which honors `VLLM_HOST_IP`;\n"
-"`rfork_seed_advertise_host` changes only the planner advertisement. To constrain the engine to a fixed port range (for example, for firewall rules), set YuanRong's\n"
-"`YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MIN` and `YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MAX` environment variables (both required, valid within `1024-65535` and\n"
-"outside the ephemeral range `32768-60999`); invalid values fall back to OS assignment. Keep this range separate from\n"
-"the seed HTTP ports and the HIXL endpoint range. The HIXL data-plane endpoints default to base port `22000`\n"
-"(`YR_TE_HIXL_BASE_PORT`, 100 ports per physical device), which stays clear of Mooncake ADXL's default `20000`-based\n"
-"segments on nodes that co-locate both engines."
-msgstr ""
-"YuanRong TransferEngine 的 RPC 端口不是配置字段：RFork 以端口 `0` "
-"初始化该引擎，引擎会绑定并持有一个由操作系统分配的端口，RFork 通过 `get_rpc_port()` "
-"读回该端口，并将其发布为传输会话端点。端点主机由 vLLM 的 `get_ip()` 独立选择，该函数会遵循 "
-"`VLLM_HOST_IP`；`rfork_seed_advertise_host` "
-"只会改变规划器广告。若要将引擎限制在固定的端口范围内（例如用于防火墙规则），请设置 YuanRong 的 `YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MIN` 和 "
-"`YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MAX` 环境变量（两者均为必需，有效范围在 `1024-65535` 内且不处于临时端口范围 "
-"`32768-60999`）；无效值会回退到由操作系统分配。请将此端口范围与种子 HTTP 端口和 HIXL 端点范围分开。HIXL "
-"数据平面端点默认使用基准端口 `22000`（`YR_TE_HIXL_BASE_PORT`，每个物理设备 100 "
-"个端口），在同时部署两种引擎的节点上，该范围与 Mooncake ADXL 默认基于 `20000` 的段保持错开。"

@@ -1478,3 +1299,195 @@ msgstr ""
 "- 每次心跳只检查 seed 服务线程是否仍在运行，不会在每个间隔发送带 key 的 HTTP 健康探测。带 key 的 `/health_check_with_key` 请求仅在服务启动期间发送，因此线程仍存活但 HTTP 监听无响应时，心跳仍可能成功。若需要区分这两种情况，请在网络层面监控已发布的 seed 端口。如果线程退出，RFork 会停止发送心跳，并在规划器支持删除时尝试撤销该 seed 广告。单次心跳故障本身不会停止元数据服务；该服务由关闭或回退清理流程处理。如果删除不受支持或状态未知，RFork 会保留已发布 seed 的已注册内存和存储所有者，直到之后确认撤销且原生清理成功，或进程退出，同时保持已加载模型可继续推理。\n"
 "- 临时的规划器故障不会停止推理。可重试的初始发布和租约释放会在后台继续。受支持的删除只会在有界重试或后续清理中重试；其他删除失败会保留 HTTP 服务和已注册内存，以便重试。永久性的规划器拒绝则会阻止 seed 晋升。故障日志仅记录首次失败、周期性摘要和恢复事件。\n"
 "- 对于新支持的 NPU 格式，应在目标 NPU 和模型组合上验证传输准确性及逻辑负载契约；CPU 测试无法证明 NPU 存储的正确性。新增格式时必须进行这项验证，但这不表示运行时需要复制张量声明负载之外的分配器或描述符填充。"

+msgid ""
+"Successful loads log `source=transfer`, `local`, `fallback`, or "
+"`shared_target`. Successful TP0 weight reads also log transfer elapsed time,"
+" bytes, chunks, and throughput at INFO; other TP ranks and per-chunk timings"
+" remain at DEBUG. Every successful registration, receiver-before-read, and "
+"final receiver stage emits one bounded `RFork tensor layout summary` at INFO"
+" per rank. The summary hashes all tensor IDs, shapes, strides, dtypes, NPU "
+"formats, logical byte counts, storage byte capacities, storage offsets, and "
+"NPU descriptor element counts into fixed-size semantic and physical digests."
+" It also reports aggregate counts and at most three representative tensors, "
+"preferring storage views or tensors whose NPU descriptor size differs from "
+"logical `numel`. Match a receiver's `peer_session` to the seed's `session`. "
+"Digest differences are diagnostic and do not by themselves reject a "
+"transfer. On checkpoint-layout transfers, compare `receiver_before_read` "
+"with `receiver_after_post_load` to determine whether the post-load hook "
+"rebuilt the layout. Processed-layout transfers instead emit "
+"`receiver_after_transfer_finalize`, because their layout processing happened"
+" before the read. The summary does not copy tensor data or prove value "
+"equality; validate output accuracy separately on NPU hardware. Set "
+"`VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG` for per-rank registration, metadata, transfer, "
+"lease-release, and publication timing."
+msgstr ""
+"成功加载会记录 `source=transfer`、`local`、`fallback` 或 `shared_target`。成功的 TP0 "
+"权重读取还会在 INFO 级别记录传输耗时、字节数、分块数和吞吐量；其他 TP rank 和每个分块的耗时仍保持在 DEBUG "
+"级别。每次成功注册、读取前的接收方以及最终接收方阶段，都会在每个 rank 上以 INFO 级别输出一条有界的 `RFork tensor layout"
+" summary`。该摘要会将所有张量 ID、形状、步长、dtype、NPU 格式、逻辑字节数、存储字节容量、存储偏移和 NPU "
+"描述符元素数量哈希为固定大小的语义摘要和物理摘要。它还会报告聚合计数以及最多三个代表性张量，优先选择存储视图或 NPU 描述符大小与逻辑 `numel`"
+" 不同的张量。将接收方的 `peer_session` 与种子实例的 `session` "
+"进行匹配。摘要差异仅用于诊断，其本身不会拒绝传输。对于检查点布局传输，比较 `receiver_before_read` 与 "
+"`receiver_after_post_load`，以判断加载后钩子是否重建了布局。已处理布局的传输则输出 "
+"`receiver_after_transfer_finalize`，因为其布局处理发生在读取之前。该摘要不会复制张量数据，也不证明值相等；请在 NPU"
+" 硬件上单独验证输出准确性。设置 `VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG` 可查看每个 rank 的注册、元数据、传输、租约释放和发布耗时。"

+msgid ""
+"- **Startup aborts with an RFork configuration error.** A required field is missing from both the JSON object and its environment variable, or a JSON-only field holds an invalid value. Check the spelling of every field — unknown keys are only warned — and re-read the resolution rules under Environment Variable Fallback.\n"
+"- **Startup aborts during RFork setup or transfer.** The failure was not a fallback-eligible error class, or it happened in a stage that cannot be retried. The exception in the log identifies the failed step; fix it and restart the workers.\n"
+"- **`source=local` in the load summary.** No usable lease was acquired: no compatible seed was available, all seeds were out of capacity, or the planner request or response failed validation. Compare the logged `seed_key` and `structural_digest` against the seed instance's values, and check the planner's lease and capacity state. The example planner allows one concurrent lease per seed unless `--default-resource-points` is raised. A lease rejected after allocation is retained for release, so the planner may still show a short-lived allocation for this attempt.\n"
+"- **`source=fallback` in the load summary.** RFork failed with a handled error in a retryable stage and fell back to the default loader. This does not imply a lease was acquired: registration initializes the TransferEngine before any seed lease. Inspect the `RFork transfer failed` WARNING and the planner warning next to it.\n"

Diff the identity log (`RFork <...> seed identity bound`) across instances. If the keys match, check whether the planner has exhausted each seed's capacity.\n"
+"- **Fingerprints match but structural digests differ.** The tensor inventories differ. Check weight dtype, NZ or fused MC2 layout switches, TP/PP/EP sharding, and quantization post-processing; use the `RFork tensor layout summary` to locate the differing tensors.\n"
+"- **Planner heartbeat or advertisement failures.** Temporary planner outages do not stop inference; retries continue in the background and logging is bounded to the first failure, periodic summaries, and recovery events. Check `rfork_scheduler_url` reachability and `rfork_request_timeout_sec`.\n"

+msgid ""

+"including the Engram weights and scales, even when a seed is available. "

+msgid ""

+"table must finish loading before destination registration or shared-weight "
+"reuse. RFork records completion for the supported DeepSeek table "
+"implementation and checks tensor identity, storage address, and checkpoint "
+"binding before exempting its host tensors from the non-NPU state check. "
+"Other registered parameters and buffers that remain on CPU are still "
+"rejected. After the default loader successfully returns, RFork records the "
+"same state so the locally loaded instance can publish its NPU weights as a "
+"seed. The model implementation and its default loading path require no RFork"
+" hooks."
+msgstr ""
+"以下主机表规则仅在启用 Engram CPU 卸载时适用。主机表必须在目标注册或共享权重复用之前完成加载。RFork 会为受支持的 DeepSeek "
+"表实现记录完成状态，并在将其主机张量从非 NPU 状态检查中豁免之前，检查张量标识、存储地址和检查点绑定。其他仍留在 CPU "
+"上的已注册参数和缓冲区仍会被拒绝。默认加载器成功返回后，RFork 会记录相同的状态，以便本地加载的实例可以将其 NPU "
+"权重发布为种子实例。模型实现及其默认加载路径无需任何 RFork 钩子。"
+
+msgid ""
+"A seed miss or transfer failure can trigger the coordinated default-loader "
+"fallback described above and cause the Engram tables to be read again. The "
+"discarded host tables are explicitly released before constructing the "
+"fallback model; cleanup failure stops loading instead of allocating a second"
+" copy. RFork accelerates the NPU portion; it does not remove host-table disk"
+" I/O. Keep the local checkpoint and seed on the same model revision, and use"
+" a distinct model identity for different checkpoints."
+msgstr ""
+"种子未命中或传输失败可能触发上述协同的默认加载器回退，并导致 Engram 表被再次读取。被丢弃的 host "
+"表会在构建回退模型之前被显式释放；清理失败会停止加载，而不是分配第二份副本。RFork 加速的是 NPU 部分；它不会消除 host 表的磁盘 "
+"I/O。请确保本地 checkpoint 和种子位于同一模型版本上，并为不同的 checkpoint 使用不同的模型标识。"
+
+msgid ""
+"If model construction fails before returning a complete model with Engram "
+"CPU offload enabled, RFork stops instead of retrying through the default "
+"loader. Partially constructed host tables cannot be safely released through "
+"the model; fix the initialization error and restart the worker."
+msgstr ""
+"如果在返回启用了 Engram CPU offload 的完整模型之前模型构建失败，RFork 会停止，而不是通过默认加载器重试。部分构建的 host "
+"表无法通过模型安全释放；请修复初始化错误并重启 worker。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For MTP drafts using `AscendDeepSeekMTP` and DeepSeek V4/V4.1 DSpark drafts,"
+" RFork prepares checkpoint-dependent state before registering tensors: head "
+"ownership and module aliases for `AscendDeepSeekMTP`, and embedding and head"
+" ownership for DSpark. It reads the names in the selected safetensors "
+"headers using the default loader's source, revision, and file-selection "
+"rules. Uncached remote checkpoints may be downloaded during this "
+"preparation. If the metadata cannot be read, including checkpoints selected "
+"in PT/bin format, RFork uses the default loader and does not publish that "
+"model as a seed. This adaptation stays within the RFork loader. For "
+"`AscendDeepSeekMTP`, it reuses the model's head-ownership helper. For "
+"DSpark, it reuses the model's checkpoint-name mapping together with the "
+"embedding/head naming rule from its `load_weights`. It currently covers only"
+" these drafts. Other draft implementations, such as `Glm5NextMTP` and other "
+"DSpark drafts, also derive head ownership from checkpoint weights, and RFork"
+" does not run their normal `load_weights` before registration; qualify "
+"`source=transfer` and output accuracy on the target model and hardware "
+"before relying on draft weight reuse."
+msgstr ""
+"对于使用 `AscendDeepSeekMTP` 的 MTP draft 以及 DeepSeek V4/V4.1 DSpark draft，RFork "
+"会在注册张量之前准备依赖 checkpoint 的状态：`AscendDeepSeekMTP` 的 head 归属和模块别名，以及 DSpark 的 "
+"embedding 和 head 归属。它使用默认加载器的 source、revision 和文件选择规则读取所选 safetensors "
+"头中的名称。在此准备过程中可能会下载未缓存的远程 checkpoint。如果无法读取元数据（包括以 PT/bin 格式选择的 "
+"checkpoint），RFork 会使用默认加载器，并且不会将该模型发布为种子。此适配仅限于 RFork 加载器内部。对于 "
+"`AscendDeepSeekMTP`，它复用模型的 head 归属辅助函数。对于 DSpark，它复用模型的 checkpoint 名称映射以及其 "
+"`load_weights` 中的 embedding/head 命名规则。目前仅覆盖这些 draft。其他 draft 实现（例如 "
+"`Glm5NextMTP` 和其他 DSpark draft）也会从 checkpoint 权重推导 head 归属，而 RFork "
+"在注册之前不会运行它们正常的 `load_weights`；在依赖 draft 权重复用之前，请在目标模型和硬件上验证 "
+"`source=transfer` 和输出精度。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When a draft model is loaded after its target model, RFork checks whether "
+"every transferable draft tensor already falls inside a weight block "
+"registered by the target. If all draft weights are shared, no draft weight "
+"is independent, and no non-NPU state remains, RFork skips destination "
+"registration, seed acquisition, and the TransferEngine copy. It also skips "
+"post-load processing, because reprocessing can mutate target-owned storage, "
+"then finalizes the model and logs `source=shared_target`. This path never "
+"contacts the planner and does not publish the draft as a separate seed."
+msgstr ""
+"当 draft 模型在其 target 模型之后加载时，RFork 会检查每个可传输的 draft 张量是否已经落在 target "
+"注册的权重块内。如果所有 draft 权重都是共享的、没有独立的 draft 权重，并且不存在非 NPU 状态，RFork 会跳过目标注册、种子获取和 "
+"TransferEngine 拷贝。它还会跳过加载后处理，因为重新处理可能会修改 target 拥有的存储，然后完成模型并记录 "
+"`source=shared_target`。此路径从不联系 planner，也不会将 draft 发布为单独的种子。"
+
+msgid ""
+"If any draft tensor is independent or any non-NPU state exists, RFork "
+"follows the normal `transfer`, `local`, or `fallback` path instead. With "
+"Engram enabled, every deployment rank must reach the same decision; a split "
+"decision aborts startup rather than mixing shared and transferred draft "
+"weights."
+msgstr ""
+"如果任何 draft 张量是独立的，或者存在任何非 NPU 状态，RFork 会改为遵循正常的 `transfer`、`local` 或 "
+"`fallback` 路径。启用 Engram 时，每个部署 rank 必须做出相同的决定；决定不一致会中止启动，而不是混合共享和传输的 draft "
+"权重。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The YuanRong TransferEngine RPC port is not a configuration field: RFork "
+"initializes the engine with port `0`, and the engine binds and holds an OS-"
+"assigned port that RFork reads back via `get_rpc_port()` and publishes as "
+"the transfer session endpoint. The endpoint host is chosen independently by "
+"vLLM's `get_ip()`, which honors `VLLM_HOST_IP`; `rfork_seed_advertise_host` "
+"changes only the planner advertisement. To constrain the engine to a fixed "
+"port range (for example, for firewall rules), set YuanRong's "
+"`YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MIN` and `YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MAX` environment variables (both "
+"required, valid within `1024-65535` and outside the ephemeral range "
+"`32768-60999`); invalid values fall back to OS assignment. Keep this range "
+"separate from the seed HTTP ports and the HIXL endpoint range. The HIXL "
+"data-plane endpoints default to base port `22000` (`YR_TE_HIXL_BASE_PORT`, "
+"100 ports per physical device), which stays clear of Mooncake ADXL's default"
+" `20000`-based segments on nodes that co-locate both engines."
+msgstr ""
+"YuanRong TransferEngine 的 RPC 端口不是配置字段：RFork 使用端口 `0` "
+"初始化引擎，引擎会绑定并持有一个由操作系统分配的端口，RFork 通过 `get_rpc_port()` 读回该端口并将其发布为传输会话端点。端点主机由"
+" vLLM 的 `get_ip()` 独立选择，该函数会遵循 `VLLM_HOST_IP`；`rfork_seed_advertise_host` "
+"仅更改 planner 通告。要将引擎限制在固定端口范围内（例如用于防火墙规则），请设置 YuanRong 的 `YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MIN`"
+" 和 `YR_TE_RPC_PORT_MAX` 环境变量（两者均为必需，有效范围在 `1024-65535` 内且不在临时端口范围 "
+"`32768-60999` 内）；无效值会回退到操作系统分配。请将此范围与种子 HTTP 端口和 HIXL 端点范围分开。HIXL "
+"数据平面端点默认使用基础端口 `22000`（`YR_TE_HIXL_BASE_PORT`，每个物理设备 100 "
+"个端口），在同时部署两个引擎的节点上，该范围与 Mooncake ADXL 默认基于 `20000` 的段保持不重叠。"

+
+msgid ""
+"| DP | Supported | Per-replica report/dump; watch multi-DP `manual_dump` "

+
+msgid ""

+"长度，而非填充后的行宽（[#22027](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-"

-"- Bug fixes:\n"

-"    - Fixed bugs and refactor cached mask generation logic. [#2442](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2442)\n"
-"    - Fixed the nz format does not work in quantization scenarios. [#2549](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2549)\n"
-"    - Fixed the accuracy issue on Qwen series caused by enabling `enable_shared_pert_dp` by default. [#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)\n"
-"    - Fixed the accuracy issue on models whose rope dim is not equal to head dim, e.g., GLM4.5. [#2601](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2601)\n"
-"- Performance improved through a lot of prs:\n"
-"    - Removed torch.cat and replaced it with List[0]. [#2153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2153)\n"
-"    - Converted the format of gmm to nz. [#2474](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2474)\n"
-"    - Optimized parallel strategies to reduce communication overhead. [#2198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2198)\n"
-"    - Optimized reject sampler in greedy situation. [#2137](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2137)\n"
-"- A batch of refactoring PRs to enhance the code architecture:\n"
-"    - Refactor on MLA. [#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
-"    - Refactor on torchair fused_moe. [#2438](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2438)\n"
-"    - Refactor on allgather/mc2-related fused_experts. [#2369](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2369)\n"
-"    - Refactor on torchair model runner. [#2208](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2208)\n"
-"    - Refactor on CI. [#2276](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2276)\n"
-"- Parameters changes:\n"
-"    - Added `lmhead_tensor_parallel_size` in `additional_config`, set it to enable lmhead tensor parallel. [#2309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2309)\n"
-"    - Some unused environment variables `HCCN_PATH`, `PROMPT_DEVICE_ID`, `DECODE_DEVICE_ID`, `LLMDATADIST_COMM_PORT` and `LLMDATADIST_SYNC_CACHE_WAIT_TIME`  are removed. [#2448](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2448)\n"
-"    - Environment variable `VLLM_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` is renamed to `VLLM_ASCEND_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` now. [#2450](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2450)\n"
-"    - Added `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLP_OPTIMIZE` in environment variables, Whether to enable mlp optimize when tensor parallel is enabled. This feature provides better performance in eager mode. [#2120](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2120)\n"
-"    - Removed `MOE_ALL2ALL_BUFFER` and `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MOE_ALL2ALL_SEQ` in environment variables. [#2612](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2612)\n"
-"    - Added `enable_prefetch` in `additional_config`, Whether to enable weight prefetch. [#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
-"    - Added `mode` in `additional_config.torchair_graph_config`, When using reduce-overhead mode for torchair, mode needs to be set. [#2461](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2461)\n"
-"    - `enable_shared_expert_dp` in `additional_config` is disabled by default now, and it is recommended to be enabled when inferencing with deepseek. [#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)"

+"    - Added `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLP_OPTIMIZE` in environment variables, Whether to enable mlp optimize when tensor parallel is enabled. This feature provides better performance in eager mode. [#2120](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2120)\n"
+"    - Removed `MOE_ALL2ALL_BUFFER` and `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MOE_ALL2ALL_SEQ` in environment variables. [#2612](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2612)\n"
+"    - Added `enable_prefetch` in `additional_config`, Whether to enable weight prefetch. [#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - Added `mode` in `additional_config.torchair_graph_config`, When using reduce-overhead mode for torchair, mode needs to be set. [#2461](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2461)\n"
+"    - `enable_shared_expert_dp` in `additional_config` is disabled by default now, and it is recommended to be enabled when inferencing with deepseek. [#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)"
+msgstr ""
+"- Bug 修复：\n"
+"    - 更新了图捕获大小计算，在一定程度上缓解了部分场景下 NPU stream 不足的问题。[#2511](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2511)\n"
+"    - 修复了若干 bug 并重构了缓存 mask 生成逻辑。[#2442](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2442)\n"
+"    - 修复了量化场景下 nz 格式不生效的问题。[#2549](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2549)\n"
+"    - 修复了因默认启用 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 导致的 Qwen 系列精度问题。[#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)\n"
+"    - 修复了 rope dim 与 head dim 不相等模型（如 GLM4.5）的精度问题。[#2601](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2601)\n"
+"- 通过大量 PR 提升了性能：\n"
+"    - 移除了 torch.cat，改用 List[0] 替代。[#2153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2153)\n"
+"    - 将 gmm 的格式转换为 nz。[#2474](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2474)\n"
+"    - 优化了并行策略以减少通信开销。[#2198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2198)\n"
+"    - 优化了贪心场景下的 reject sampler。[#2137](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2137)\n"
+"- 一批用于增强代码架构的重构 PR：\n"
+"    - MLA 重构。[#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - torchair fused_moe 重构。[#2438](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2438)\n"
+"    - allgather/mc2 相关 fused_experts 重构。[#2369](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2369)\n"
+"    - torchair model runner 重构。[#2208](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2208)\n"
+"    - CI 重构。[#2276](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2276)\n"
+"- 参数变更：\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config` 中新增 `lmhead_tensor_parallel_size`，设置该参数以启用 lmhead 张量并行。[#2309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2309)\n"
+"    - 移除了一些未使用的环境变量 `HCCN_PATH`、`PROMPT_DEVICE_ID`、`DECODE_DEVICE_ID`、`LLMDATADIST_COMM_PORT` 和 `LLMDATADIST_SYNC_CACHE_WAIT_TIME`。[#2448](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2448)\n"
+"    - 环境变量 `VLLM_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` 现已重命名为 `VLLM_ASCEND_LLMDD_RPC_PORT`。[#2450](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2450)\n"
+"    - 在环境变量中新增 `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLP_OPTIMIZE`，用于控制启用张量并行时是否开启 mlp 优化。该特性在 eager 模式下可提供更好的性能。[#2120](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2120)\n"
+"    - 移除了环境变量 `MOE_ALL2ALL_BUFFER` 和 `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MOE_ALL2ALL_SEQ`。[#2612](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2612)\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config` 中新增 `enable_prefetch`，用于控制是否启用权重预取。[#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config.torchair_graph_config` 中新增 `mode`，当 torchair 使用 reduce-overhead 模式时需要设置该参数。[#2461](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2461)\n"
+"    - `additional_config` 中的 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 现已默认禁用，建议在使用 deepseek 推理时启用。[#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)"

commits.message:
[Feature][KV Pool] Unify Decode cache saving and role-based lookup (#22713)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

- Use `enable_lookup` to control external KV Pool probing. It defaults
to enabled for `kv_producer`/`kv_both` and disabled for `kv_consumer`,
while allowing an explicit override.
- Use `save_decode_cache` as the sole Decode-side save option for
complete Decode KV blocks in blockwise and layerwise Store paths. P-to-D
Prefill KV is not saved during Prefill; the first Decode save fills only
missing Prefill ancestor blocks.
- Reject the old `consumer_is_to_load` and `consumer_is_to_put` options
with migration hints so existing configs do not silently change
behavior. Update the deployment guides and Chinese translations.
- Adapt the layerwise save path to the current block-key/GVA data-plane
split on upstream `main`.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Decode lookup is disabled by default, and the old consumer options
now require migration to `enable_lookup` and `save_decode_cache`. The
release note fragment is in release_notes/fragments/22713.yaml.

### How was this patch tested?

- CPU unit tests for AscendStore connector, scheduler, layerwise worker,
and reuse snapshots: **329 passed, 9 deselected, 302 subtests passed**.
The 9 excluded cases require the local vLLM `kv_cache_planning` module
(8 parametrizations) or ZMQ IPC bind access (1), which this macOS
sandbox lacks.
- Focused new behavior tests: **8 passed, 9 subtests passed**.
- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `python -m py_compile` (14
changed Python files), and `git diff --check` passed.
- `bash format.sh ci` was attempted. Pre-commit initialization stops in
`nodeenv` while parsing the prebuilt Node version `27.0.0-alpha.0.1.1`.
Direct Markdown lint reports only the existing MD060 table alignment
issues in `DeepSeek-V4-Flash.md` lines 34–36, outside this diff.
- NPU execution and PD end-to-end validation remain for CI or hardware
testing.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: Role defaults and explicit
overrides, blockwise/layerwise Decode save, and existing Prefill
ancestors are covered.
- [x] **Regression test**: Legacy option migration and Decode save
behavior are covered.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: Legacy options raise an
actionable startup error.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: Tests assert the lookup path and
Store key allocation behavior.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: Hardware performance measurements are
pending.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

---------

Signed-off-by: weijinqian0 <1184188277@qq.com>

[Feature][Model] Add support_torch_compile for Step5 (#22342)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Following up on #20946 , this PR adds support_torch_compile for Step5.
Now Step5 can activate FULL_AND_PIECEWISE mode.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

Step5 Double Node A5 DT Pod
| Dataset | Acc |
| --- | --- |
| GPQA | 92.42/93.43 |
---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: I reviewed whether this change
involves
boundary conditions (e.g. empty input, single/zero element, min/max
values,
off-by-one, sequence-length limits, integer overflow). Where applicable,
I
added unit tests covering these edge cases in `tests/ut/` or
`tests/e2e/`.
- [x] **Regression test**: If this PR fixes a bug, I added a regression
test
  that would fail without the fix.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: I covered abnormal paths
(exceptions,
timeouts, out-of-range, division by zero) in addition to the happy path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: New tests assert real behavior
and are
  not written merely to satisfy CI.
- [x] **Performance impact**: If this PR touches a performance-sensitive
path,
  I attached benchmark results and added performance regression tests.

[CI] Update coverage check script (#22414)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
- Fixes: #20581 

This PR reworks the coverage-checking pipeline so that the coverage
comment on a PR is driven by a single, structured source and only runs
when the PR actually changes source code.

**`coverage_comment.py` (rewritten)**

- Added `--input-json` (a slipcover `coverage.json`) alongside the
  existing diff-cover input. The script now reads the *overall* repo
  coverage from slipcover and the *diff* coverage from diff-cover and
  renders them side by side as a 4x3 Markdown table:

  |              | Total Coverage | Diff Coverage |
  | ------------ | -------------- | ------------- |
  | **Total**    | … lines        | … lines       |
  | **Missing**  | … lines        | … lines       |
  | **Coverage** | 71%            | 55% |

**`_selected_tests.yaml`**

- Added a `dorny/paths-filter` step that recomputes the `src` path
  category (the same list used by `pr_test.yaml`) inside the job, so the
  workflow can tell when a PR touches source code.
- Gated the coverage steps (slipcover trio + diff-coverage /
  PR-coverage-comment generation) on
  `steps.filter.outputs.src == 'true'`, so non-source PRs skip coverage
  generation entirely.

**`pr_test.yaml`**

- Gated `upload-pr-context` on
  `needs.pre-commit.outputs.src == 'true'` so non-source PRs no longer
  upload the `pr-context` artifact that the comment workflow consumes.

**`post_fork_coverage_comment.yaml`**

- Removed the `pull_request_target` trigger (a dead path that always ran
  before `cpu-ut` finished, so the `coverage-report` artifact was never
  present and the comment step was always skipped). The
  `workflow_run: E2E completed` trigger is now the sole entry point,
  which is also the only one that can actually download the artifact.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes — the format of the coverage comment posted on PRs changes: it is
now
a single table showing overall and diff coverage together, with
out-of-threshold
values highlighted instead of a red bullet. This is a developer-facing
CI behavior change (not a runtime/model change), so no release-note
fragment is added. CI testing only (the comment is produced by the
workflow on NPU/CPU runners in CI).

### How was this patch tested?

- Unit-verified the rewritten `coverage_comment.py` locally by feeding
it
a representative `coverage.json` and a diff-cover `diff_coverage.md` and
  checking the rendered table (threshold highlight on/off, and the
  `N/A` diff column when the diff report is absent).
- The coverage-comment rendering is exercised end-to-end by CI on every
  PR that changes `src` paths; I did not run NPU/E2E locally (no NPU
  hardware available), so that evidence comes from CI.

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [ ] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: `coverage_comment.py` handles
the
     missing `coverage.json`, a `coverage.json` without a top-level
     `summary`, and a missing `diff_coverage.md` (diff column renders
     `N/A`); verified locally. No `tests/ut/` case added yet for the new
     table renderer — flagging for reviewers whether a unit test in
     `tests/ut/` is expected for this CI script.
- [ ] **Regression test**: N/A — this is a CI/coverage-tooling change,
not
     a bug fix in the library.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: the failure paths of
     `coverage_comment.py` (missing files / malformed JSON) are covered
     by the local runs above.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: the local verification asserted
the
     actual rendered Markdown, not just exit codes.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: N/A — no performance-sensitive path
touched;
     the change only affects CI comment generation.

[Feature][MoE] Fuse the shared expert into the A3 MegaMoe operator for W8A8 (enable_fused_mc2=3) (#22207)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

`enable_fused_mc2=3` (MegaMoe shared-expert fusion) was gated on the A5
MXFP
contract only, so A3 (`910_93`) W8A8 INT8 deployments always fell back
to the
separate shared-expert forward. A3 runs the shared expert inside the
same
MegaMoe operator for the INT layouts, and this PR enables that path.

Changes:

1. `vllm_ascend/device/hardware_profile.py`: new capability
`CANN_MEGAMOE_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSION_INT` added to the A3 capability set.
The
   MXFP variant (`CANN_MEGAMOE_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSION`) stays A5-only.
2.
`vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py::_validate_megamoe_shared_expert_fusion`:
accept the flag when the platform advertises either the FP (MXFP) or the
INT
   fusion capability; the error message now names both platforms.
3. `vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/shared_experts.py`:
- `_setup_megamoe_shared_fusion` branches on the MXFP vs INT capability.
The
     INT path allows routed `QuantType.W8A8` / `W4A8`.
- `_collect_megamoe_shared_weight` builds the INT8 shared payload with
the
routed layout, i.e. logical `(in, out)`: `(hidden, 2*inter)` for `w1`
and
`(inter, hidden)` for `w2`, cast to `FRACTAL_NZ`. The A5 `(out, in)`
     transpose is applied only for the non-int8 dtypes.
- The INT8 per-channel dequant scale is packed as one fp32 inside a
`uint64`
(`view(torch.int32).to(torch.int64).view(torch.uint64)`) and passed 1-D
ND.
4. `vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/moe_comm_method.py`: forward
`shared_weight1_type` / `shared_weight2_type` whenever the shared fusion
advertises a weight type (previously only when it differed from the
routed
   type), so the operator resolves the INT8 shared GMM mode.

### INT8 layout and scale contract

The routed INT8 experts define the contract the shared GMM reuses:

- weight: logical `(in, out)`, `ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ`, one `int8` per
element
(`w1` is `(hidden, 2*inter)`, `w2` is `(inter, hidden)`). No transpose.
- dequant scale: per-channel, one fp32 value carried in a `uint64`,
passed as a
  1-D ND tensor. This matches the A3 epilogue
(`ScaleType = GemmType<uint64_t, VectorLayout>` in `mega_moe_arch22.h`).
A
  bf16 scale is silently reinterpreted by the epilogue and corrupts the
shared-expert output, so the packed default is not optional for
correctness.

### Bring-up A/B switches

Three environment switches are kept while the INT8 shared layout is
still being
cross-checked against CANN versions. They are bring-up aids, not
user-facing
configuration, and the defaults are the validated shape:

- `MEGAMOE_SH_INT8_WEIGHT_LAYOUT` (`nz` default | `nd`)
- `MEGAMOE_SH_INT8_SCALE_LAYOUT` (`col` default | `row` | `exp` |
`col3`, only
  consulted when the scale is not packed)
- `MEGAMOE_SH_INT8_SCALE_DTYPE` (`uint64` default | `bf16`)

The chosen payload shape is logged once per process. Happy to drop them
before
merge if reviewers prefer a fixed layout.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes: `enable_fused_mc2=3` now works on A3 with W8A8 / W4A8 quantization,
and the
rejection message on unsupported hardware names the supported platforms.
A
release note fragment is added in this PR.

### How was this patch tested?

Measured on a PD-separated deployment of a W8A8 INT8 MoE model on 2 x
8-die
Atlas 800I A3 (`910_93`):

- Accuracy gate: GSM8K 1319 passed.
- Decode TPOT: ~120-131 ms before -> 56-66 ms after.
- E2E throughput: +1.6-1.8x.
- 7 PD performance groups measured (prefill/decode, multiple concurrency
/
  input-output lengths); all consistent with the numbers above.

Local checks: `python -m py_compile` on the four changed files, plus
`ruff check` and `ruff format --check` (all clean).

Unit tests were not added: the path needs a real MegaMoe operator on
NPU, so the
layout/scale contract is verified through the accuracy gate and perf
groups
above rather than a CPU test. Nothing is claimed for hardware other than
A3
W8A8; A5 keeps its existing MXFP behavior.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Performance impact**: benchmark results attached in the section
above;
the change only adds a fused path behind `enable_fused_mc2=3` (default
off).
- [ ] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: not applicable to a
CPU-testable unit;
the gate falls back to the separate shared-expert forward on any
unsupported
  dtype/shape/quant type.
- [ ] **Regression test**: no bug fix here.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: the existing
`_disable_megamoe_shared_fusion`
  and shape-check paths are reused unchanged for the INT8 branch.
- [ ] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: covered by the E2E accuracy/perf
evidence.
